name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: LABÁCI (Děčínský horolezecký oddíl a Klub orientačního běhu Děčín)
description: Běh Labským údolím je tradiční podzimní běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Dolního Žlebu nedaleko Děčína. Závod nabízí tratě různých délek, které vedou převážně lesními cestami a stezkami s členitým terénem. Pořádá ho skupina Labáci, která navazuje na dlouholetou tradici místních pořadatelů. Závod je součástí Děčínského běžeckého poháru a je vhodný pro širokou běžeckou veřejnost včetně veteránů a dorostu.
course_highlights: 16 km hlavní trať a 8 km zkrácená trať v členitém terénu
Převaha lesních cest a stezek
Malebné podzimní prostředí Labského údolí
additional: Prezentace závodníků probíhá v den závodu od 10:45 hodin v hospodě „U Kosti“ v Dolním Žlebu. Doporučený příjezd na závod je vlakem. Závod je součástí Děčínského běžeckého poháru. Registrace budou spuštěny v průběhu jara 2026. Registrace probíhá do 30. října 2025, start je naplánován na 1. listopadu v 12:00, prezentace do 10:45. K dispozici je možnost dopravy vlakem z Děčína.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky je třetí ročník podzimního trailového závodu v historických lázních Velichovky. Nabízí pestrý a nádherný běžecký terén s startem i cílem na lázeňské kolonádě, kde je k dispozici kryté zázemí se šatnami a restaurací. Závod je doplněn o lázeňský servis včetně kavárničky a poskytuje originální medaile, dárky a startovní balíček. Atmosféra je přátelská a závod je vhodný pro všechny milovníky trailového běhu i lázeňského prostředí.
course_highlights: Nejbarevnější podzimní běžecký terén
Start a cíl na lázeňské kolonádě
Kryté zázemí s šatnami a restaurací
additional: Závod zahrnuje originální medaili, startovní balíček, elektronický čip pro měření času, občerstvení během závodu i v cíli, šatny, úschovnu zavazadel, toalety, zdravotnickou službu a doprovodný program. K dispozici je také prodej oblečení Gladiator Race a parkování v blízkosti centra závodu. Registrace online přes reg-sportvisio.cz, medaile, čipové časomíry, fotografie z trati, diplomy, občerstvení a lázeňské služby.

name: Jizerun
location: stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: přátelé a sportovní nadšenci z Hitgymu

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Jizerun je štafetový běžecký závod, který propojuje Prahu a Jizerské hory. Týmy o 4-5 členech běží celkem 164 km po cyklostezkách a jizerskohorských trailech během jednoho dne. Závod nabízí jedinečný týmový zážitek s možností výběru ze dvou startovních balíčků, které zahrnují různé výhody jako sportovní triko, čelenku, večerní raut a finisher medaile. Akce je vhodná pro mužské, ženské, smíšené i firemní štafety a je podporována generálním partnerem Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km trasa z Prahy do Jizerských hor
Kombinace cyklostezek a jizerskohorských trailů
Štafety 4-5členných týmů s minimálně 3 úseky na běžce
additional: Startovní balíčky jsou týmové pro 5 osob. Balíček RUN&FUN obsahuje trička, čelenky, večeři formou rautu, finisher medaile, občerstvení, startovní čísla, GPS tracking a finisher párty s živou hudbou. Balíček NO FUN, JUST RUN obsahuje finisher medaile, občerstvení, startovní čísla, GPS tracking a finisher párty. K dispozici je mobilní WC, sprchy v cíli, zdravotní služba, speaker a kompletní zajištění akce. Při přihlášce je nutné vyplnit detaily kapitána a později doplnit složení týmu a velikosti triček. Každý člen týmu musí běžet minimálně 3 úseky a je povoleno pouze jedno auto na tým. Závod podporuje sbírku na podporu hospice a hospicové péče v ČR, registrace začíná v dubnu 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně je tradiční běžecký závod v Horažďovicích, který nabízí trať dlouhou 9,5 km. Od roku 2024 vede inovovaná trasa, která kopíruje Horažďovický zelený vycházkový okruh. Start i cíl jsou umístěny před Envicentrem PROUD, kde je zajištěno zázemí pro běžce včetně šaten, WC a občerstvení. Vyhlášení výsledků probíhá přibližně v 12:00 po závodě. Pořadateli jsou DDM Horažďovice a KČT Horažďovice, kteří se starají o příjemnou atmosféru a hladký průběh akce.
course_highlights: Trať dlouhá 9,5 km kopíruje Horažďovický zelený vycházkový okruh
Start a cíl před Envicentrem PROUD s kompletním zázemím
Smíšený typ závodu v malebném prostředí Horažďovic
additional: Vyhlášení výsledků probíhá přibližně v 12:00 v Envicentru PROUD, kde je zajištěno občerstvení, šatny a WC. Trať kopíruje Horažďovický zelený vycházkový okruh, start a cíl před Envicentrem PROUD, občerstvení a zázemí po běhu

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: Běh na 2 míle ve Zlíně - Přílukách je otevřený závod na 3,2 km určený pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců, od začátečníků po zkušené. Trať vede převážně mezi zahradami v průmyslové zóně Příluky-Zlín a je tvořena necelými dvěma koly přesně změřeného asfaltového okruhu. Závod se koná každou první sobotu v měsíci s registrací před budovou firmy Madal Bal a startem v 9:00. Na každého účastníka čeká v cíli teplý lívanec se skořicí jako odměna za snahu.
course_highlights: Trať vede z velké části mezi zahradami v průmyslové zóně Příluky-Zlín
Přesně změřený asfaltový okruh o délce necelých 2 kol (3,2 km)
Dětská trať má délku 800 m
additional: Registrace probíhá před budovou firmy Madal Bal od 8:15 do 8:55. Kategorie jsou rozděleny na muže a ženy od 13 let a starší, a děti do 12 let (kluci a holky). Čas je měřen každému závodníkovi, první tři místa v kategoriích dospělých i dětí jsou odměněna malými cenami. Doporučený přístup na start je na kole, pěšky, autem, kolečkových bruslích nebo trolejbusem č. 11 (zastávka Průmyslová zóna). Závody se konají první sobotu v měsíci, start v 9:00, registrace od 8:15 do 8:55, možnost přijít na kole, pěšky, autem nebo trolejbusem. Trať je přesně změřený asfaltový okruh, délka hlavní trati je 3,2 km a dětská trať má délku 800 m.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: Běžecký festival Otrokovice je tradiční sportovní událostí, která nabízí širokou škálu závodů včetně maratonu, půlmaratonu, štafetového půlmaratonu, decimaratonu a závodů mládeže. Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka je vrcholným závodem půlmaratonu, který se koná v krásném prostředí Otrokovic. Závodníci si mohou užít kvalitní trať s elektronickým měřením času a atmosféru běžeckého festivalu s bohatým programem pro všechny věkové kategorie. Prezentace a vyhlášení vítězů probíhají v Městské sportovní hale Otrokovice.
course_highlights: Trať půlmaratonu a maratonu v Otrokovicích s měřením času čipem
Okruh decimaratonu o délce 4,2195 km
Závody mládeže s různými délkami od 200 m do 1700 m
additional: Prezentace závodníků probíhá v Městské sportovní hale Otrokovice. Závodníci jsou povinni si převzít startovní číslo a čip pro elektronické měření času. Vyhlášení vítězů probíhá postupně po jednotlivých závodech, účast vítězů na vyhlášení je povinná. Registrace probíhá přes e-mail, akce zahrnuje různé věkové kategorie a závody na městských ulicích a sportovní hale

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Berouně, který nabízí dvě hlavní trasy o délce 11 a 18 kilometrů. Start i cíl jsou umístěny na atletickém stadionu TJ Lokomotiva Beroun. Trasy vedou převážně po asfaltu a cyklostezkách podél řeky Berounky a Loděnického potoka, s obrátkami v osadě V Kozle (11 km) a v Svatém Janu pod Skálou (18 km). Závod je otevřený široké věkové kategorii a nabízí občerstvení v cíli, stejně jako finanční a věcné ceny pro nejlepší běžce.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou převážně po asfaltu a cyklostezkách podél řeky Berounky a Loděnického potoka
Obrátka 11 km trati je v osadě V Kozle, obrátka 18 km trati v Svatém Janu pod Skálou
Start i cíl na atletickém stadionu TJ Lokomotiva Beroun
additional: Prezentace a registrace na místě v den závodu od 11:00 do 12:40. Předem přihlášení závodníci s platbou do 5.11. obdrží startovní číslo se jménem. Občerstvení v cíli zahrnuje čaj a sušenky. Závod se koná za plného silničního provozu, účastníci musí dodržovat pravidla silničního provozu a startují na vlastní nebezpečí. Parkování je možné v okolí stadionu, doporučují se přilehlá parkoviště kvůli modrým zónám. Závod nabízí možnost registrace online i na místě, jsou vyhlašovány medaile, certifikáty a jsou vypláceny peněžní ceny.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka je tradiční městský silniční běh dlouhý 5 kilometrů, který se koná v Baťovském areálu ve Zlíně. Závod je určen jak dospělým, tak dětem, a pořádá ho Kovárna VIVA ve spolupráci se spolkem Běhy Zlín. Akce nabízí kvalitní sportovní zážitek v centru krajského města s mezinárodní účastí. Každoročně přitahuje širokou běžeckou komunitu a je známá svou přátelskou atmosférou a dobře organizovaným průběhem.
course_highlights: Trasa vede bývalým Baťovským areálem ve Zlíně
Silniční běh na 5 kilometrů v městském prostředí
Závod je vhodný pro dospělé i děti
additional: Závod je součástí celoroční soutěže běžců Zlínska. Pořadatelé poskytují online výsledky a fotografie z akce. V rámci závodu jsou vypsány i dětské kategorie. Organizace zajišťuje kvalitní časomíru a podporu běžecké komunity v regionu. Závod je součástí série běhů ve Zlíně, nabízí různé věkové kategorie a je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: Běh na 2 míle v pražské Stromovce je otevřený závod na 3,2 km určený pro všechny věkové kategorie a úrovně běžců, včetně dětí do 12 let, které běží 1,6 km. Závod je vhodný pro běžce pomalé i rychlé, zkušené i začátečníky, kteří si chtějí zlepšit osobní rekord, zatrénovat nebo si jen příjemně zaběhat v krásném prostředí parku. Po doběhu čeká na každého teplý lívanec se skořicí. Čas se měří každému a výsledky jsou zveřejňovány online, přičemž se započítávají do celoročního Lívancového poháru.
course_highlights: Trať vede po asfaltových cestách Stromovky
Dospělí běží 2 kola (2 míle, 3,2 km), děti 1 kolo (1,6 km)
Závod se koná v krásném prostředí parku Královská obora - Stromovka
additional: Registrace probíhá v prostoru Bruselské brány (pod budovou Maroldova panoramatu) od 8:15 do 8:45, možnost předchozí online registrace pro rychlejší odbavení. Doporučený příjezd na kole, pěšky, kolečkových bruslích nebo tramvají (zastávka Výstaviště). Parkování u mostu na Císařský ostrov v ulici Za elektrárnou. K dispozici jsou stany na převlečení a odložení věcí (nehlídané) a mobilní úschovna cenností. Na místě jsou WC kabinky. Start v 9.07 h, registrace od 8.15 do 8.45 h, možnost online registrace, závod se koná v parku Královská obora - Stromovka, parkování u mostu na Císařský ostrov, šatny a WC k dispozici.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: Labský půlmaraton je běžecký závod konaný v Lysé nad Labem, který nabízí dvě trasy o délce přibližně 12,5 km a 21,3 km. Trasy vedou rovinatým polabským lesem s povrchem kombinujícím zpevněné i nezpevněné cesty, pěšiny a krátké úseky asfaltu či betonu. Start i cíl jsou na dostihovém závodišti, kde je zajištěno občerstvení, úschovna zavazadel a další zázemí. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a kapacita je omezena na 700 startujících. Součástí programu jsou také dětské závody s různými délkami podle věku.
course_highlights: Trasy vedou po rovině krásným polabským lesem
Start po cca 1 km na dostihové dráze
Občerstvovací stanice na 8. a 17. km (21 km trasa), jedna stanice na 8. km (12 km trasa)
additional: Kapacita závodu je omezena na 700 startujících. Pro závodníky je k dispozici úschovna zavazadel, stany pro převlékání, WC, občerstvení a tombola. Parkování v areálu za poplatek 50 Kč/auto. Dětské závody s délkou od 200 do 1000 metrů podle věku. Trasa je značena fáborky, cedulkami a šipkami z mouky, každý kilometr je orientačně označen. závod zahrnuje dětské závody, registrace je možná online, a trasa může být upravena kvůli rekonstrukcím v okolí

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice je štafetový běžecký závod dvojic, který nabízí jedinečný zážitek z týmového běhu v krásném prostředí Hostivaře. Závod je určen pro dvojice, které si chtějí užít sportovní výzvu a zároveň si užít atmosféru přátelského závodu. Trasa vede malebným terénem a je vhodná pro běžce všech úrovní. Přijďte si zaběhat a zažít skvělou sportovní akci v příjemné komunitě.
course_highlights: Štafetový běh ve dvojicích
Malebné prostředí Hostivaře
Přátelská atmosféra závodu
additional: Závod se koná 7. listopadu 2026 v Kladně, jedná se o týmovou štafetovou disciplínu, registrace jsou dostupné online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v Frýdku-Místku, který se koná již od roku 1980 s přestávkami a obnovením tradice v roce 1996. Závod nabízí různé běžecké disciplíny včetně závodů mládeže, běhu pro zdraví a hlavního závodu na 10 km. Akce je oslavou pohybu a sportovního ducha, přitahuje stovky až tisíce účastníků všech věkových kategorií a je známá svou výbornou organizací a přátelskou atmosférou. Startuje se u Národního domu ve Frýdku-Místku a závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost včetně rodin s dětmi.
course_highlights: Trať vede v okolí Frýdku-Místku s historií sahající do roku 1980
Hlavní závod na 10 km s doprovodnými závody mládeže a běhu pro zdraví
Start a cíl u Národního domu ve Frýdku-Místku
additional: Závod zahrnuje nesoutěžní běh rodičů s dětmi, závody mládeže, běh pro zdraví a hlavní závod na 10 km. Akce je známá svou výbornou organizací a pohodovou atmosférou. Pořadatelem je Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. Závod se koná v sobotu 7. listopadu 2026 na národní dům v Frýdku-Místku, akce zahrnuje uzavírky silnic a dopravní opatření.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country je tradiční krosový závod pořádaný atletickým klubem AC Pardubice. Závod se koná v okolí řeky Labe a blízko kanoistického klubu TJ Dynamo Pardubice. Pořadatelé srdečně zvou všechny běžce i fanoušky běhání na tuto oblíbenou akci, která nabízí sportovní zážitek v přírodním prostředí. Propozice a další informace jsou k dispozici na webových stránkách klubu.
course_highlights: Krosový závod v přírodním terénu v okolí řeky Labe
Start a cíl v blízkosti kanoistického klubu TJ Dynamo Pardubice
Tradiční běžecká akce pořádaná AC Pardubice
additional: Závod se koná 7. listopadu 2026, je určen pro širokou veřejnost včetně dětí a mládeže, a je součástí místního sportovního kalendáře.

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Obsahuje : 5x finisher medaile, předstartovní káva a drobné občerstvení na startu a v cíli, startovní čísla, výsledkový servis a online GPS tracker, finisher párty s živou hudbou.

description: Jizerun je štafetový běžecký závod, který vede z Prahy do Jizerských hor podél řeky Jizery. Týmy o 4-5 členech absolvují celkem 165 km po cyklostezkách a jizerskohorských trailech během jednoho dne. Závod nabízí jedinečný sportovní zážitek a možnost týmové spolupráce v mužských, ženských, smíšených i firemních kategoriích. Trasa je rozdělena do několika úseků s různou náročností, což umožňuje vybrat si vhodný segment pro každého běžce.
course_highlights: 165 km trasa z Prahy do Jizerek po cyklostezkách a trailech
Štafetový závod 4-5členných týmů s různými kategoriemi
Úseky s náročností od 1 do 8 na stupnici 10, různorodý terén
additional: V ceně startovného je časomíra, GPX tracking a aplikace JIZERUN, mobilní WC, zázemí v cíli včetně sprch, speaker a zvuk, zdravotní služba po celou dobu závodu, dárky od partnerů, fotografie a video, kompletní personální zajištění akce a všech příslušných povolení. Trasa je rozdělena do 14 úseků s různou délkou a náročností, například úsek Bradlec - Klášter má 14,7 km a náročnost 7/10. Ročník 2026 je vyprodaný; pořadatel zmiňuje čekací listinu. Běží se ve čtyř- až pětičlenných týmech.

name: Během proti závislostem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: MUŽI, ŽENY, HOŠI, DÍVKY – 150,- Kč. Online

description: Během proti závislostem je běžecký závod v Lesoparku Homolka v Plzni, který nabízí tratě pro různé věkové kategorie od dětí až po dospělé. Trať je vedena po zpevněných cestách a zahrnuje jak rovinaté dětské tratě, tak členitý terén hlavního závodu na 6 km. Součástí je také štafetový závod tříčlenných družstev, kde každý běží jedno kolo. Akce je vhodná pro všechny běžce, kteří chtějí podpořit boj proti závislostem a užít si sportovní atmosféru v přírodě.
course_highlights: Trať vede po zpevněných cestách Lesoparku Homolka
Hlavní závod 6 km má členitý terén a tři okruhy
Dětské tratě jsou rovinaté a přizpůsobené věkovým kategoriím
additional: Startovní čísla se vydávají od 9:00 do 10:30. Závody dětí začínají od 10:00 s postupným startem podle věkových kategorií. Hlavní závod mužů, žen a štafet startuje v 11:30. Štafeta je tříčlenná, každý člen běží jedno kolo cca 2 000 m. Vyhlášení výsledků je plánováno na 12:15. Doporučená trasa je dostupná na Garmin Connect s jedním okruhem, který se v závodě pojede třikrát. Pořadatel uvádí dětské běhy a závod na 6 km; Kudy z nudy uvádí pro rok 2026 také štafetu 3×2 km. Propozice dostupné na webu pořadatele se týkají ročníků 2024 a 2025, proto ceny z těchto ročníků nejsou přiřazeny k závodu v roce 2026.

name: 14. Sollingquerung
description: The Solling Crossing is a unique run from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen, taking place on November 7, 2026. The course is run exclusively by GPS, as it is not marked, making the event particularly challenging and exciting. The field is limited to 100 participants, creating a friendly atmosphere. The start is at 9:00 a.m., after runners are taken by bus from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen at 7:45 a.m. A tip for runners: anyone who completes the marathon distance at the Solling Run on June 6, 2026, is guaranteed a starting place in the Solling Crossing.
course_highlights: Course from Bad Karlshafen to Dassel
No course markings; GPS navigation only
Aid stations along the course
additional: Start at 9:00 a.m. after the 7:45 a.m. bus ride from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen. Field limited to 100 participants. No course markings; GPS navigation only. Tip: A starting place is guaranteed to participants in the Solling Run marathon on June 6, 2026. The course is unmarked, GPS navigation is required, November weather may bring rain and temperatures of around 2–7°C, no on-site entries are possible, and the event sells out quickly.

name: 6. Weserbergland Backyard Ultra
description: The Weserbergland Backyard Ultra Run is a unique ultrarunning event in Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, held every year in November. Participants run a lap of about 6.7 kilometers every hour until only one runner remains. The race stands out for its distinctive challenge and the camaraderie among runners. The event is known for its demanding course and the impressive performances of participants, who often run for many hours and cover many kilometers.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 6.7 km per lap
A loop course with challenging climbs on the Heiligenberg
A run through varied terrain in the Weserbergland
additional: The race traditionally starts at 10 a.m. Registration usually fills up quickly, and the field often reaches capacity early. There is currently no waiting list. The event is organized by TuS Lütmarsen e. V. Participant numbers are limited to ensure the quality and safety of the event. It is one of Germany's last major Backyard events of the year, with typical November weather and long nights. Registration opens on 1 May 2026.

name: Freundschaftslauf der LLG Wustweiler
description: The 22nd Friendship Run of LLG Wustweiler takes place on November 7, 2026, at the Dorfwaldhalle Wustweiler. The event begins at 1:00 p.m. with the Wustweiler Beaver Trail (WuBiT), a challenging trail route, followed at 3:00 p.m. by running and walking groups. This is not a race and there is no timing; the focus is instead on enjoying exercise in nature and in good company. The route follows official forest paths and trails, with a small refreshment station at kilometer 12. Afterwards, participants can gather for food and drinks in the hall.
course_highlights: Challenging route along official forest paths and trails
Small refreshment station at kilometer 12 (no cups)
Three groups at different running paces, accompanied by LLG runners
additional: This is not a race and there is no timing. There are three groups at different paces (6–6:30, 7–7:30, and 8–8:30 min/km), accompanied by experienced LLG runners. The running and walking groups each run or walk for one hour. The route is approximately 7 to 11 km for runners and 5 to 6 km for walkers/hikers. The GPX file for the route is available to download. The event is part of the LLG Illtal Cup, together with the Illinger City Run and the Benin Benefit Run. A hot-air balloon ride will be raffled among participants who complete all three events (participants must be 18 or older; LLG members are not eligible). No race or timing; challenging forest paths and trails; trail shoes are recommended; participation is at your own risk; social gathering after the run.

name: Geilenkirchener Crosslauf
location: Teverener Heide, Geilenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Geilenkirchen Cross Country Run takes place on 7 November 2026 in the Teverener Heide near Geilenkirchen. Organized by ATV Geilenkirchen, the event has offered a compact, local program since 2006, with distances from 1.1 km to 9.2 km for adults, young people, and children. The course is a true cross-country route with some substantial undulations, running through the heathland and starting and finishing at the Grotenrath parking lot. With usually 101 to 300 participants, the race has a friendly club atmosphere in a natural setting.
course_highlights: A true cross-country course with substantial undulations
Run through the heathland of the Teverener Heide
Start and finish at the Grotenrath parking lot
additional: The race takes place in November, with typical November weather of around 7 °C and rainy days. Participant numbers are usually between 101 and 300 runners. Separate races are held for adults, young people, and children. Run in the Teverener Heide, cross-country race with various distances, more of a club atmosphere, November weather with rain and temperatures around 2–7°C

name: Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf
description: The Heiner Mayr Staffelberg Relay is a challenging mountain relay taking place on November 7, 2026, in Bad Staffelstein. Organized by TSV 1860 Staffelstein e.V. with support from Sparkasse Coburg-Lichtenfels, the route covers 3,960 meters and 260 meters of elevation gain, from the start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße up to the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel. Runners can expect a challenging race with impressive views across the Franconian countryside. The race pays tribute to decades of dedication to running in the region.
course_highlights: 3,960-meter course with 260 meters of elevation gain
Start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße in Bad Staffelstein
Finish on the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel, with panoramic views
additional: Mountain relay, starts at 2 p.m., finish on the Staffelberg plateau, registration until November 6, 2026, open to all age groups

name: Internationaler Fackellauf
description: The 45th International Torch Run in Rodenbach takes place on November 7, 2026, and offers a challenging 7 km course for adults. The course is a hilly loop with a total of 92 metres of ascent and descent, appealing to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers alike. In addition to the main event, there are also races for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official race announcement. The start is at 18:00, and all events share the same finish.
course_highlights: 7 km hilly loop
92 metres of ascent and descent
Very challenging, hilly course
additional: Races for children and young people are offered; see the organizer’s official race announcement for details. All events share the same finish location. The exact finish location display requires RUNME Premium. The event takes place on November 7, 2026, starting at 18:00, with accommodation options near the start and finish area. The event is part of the Red Cross’s international humanitarian commitment, conveying a message of hope and peace.

name: Lauf der 17. OIE-Nahe-Crosslaufserie
description: The OIE-Nahe Cross-Country Series is a long-running running series held in the region around Idar-Oberstein. It includes several races on varied cross-country courses, catering to both middle- and long-distance runners. Participants who take part in at least four races in the series receive a series gift—in 2026, sports socks. The series is organized by TuS Oberbrombach and places great emphasis on community and the enjoyment of sport.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses in the Idar-Oberstein region
Middle- and long-distance races with challenging sections
Series standings with attractive gifts for frequent participants
additional: Participants who take part in at least four races in the series receive a series gift (sports socks for the middle- and long-distance races). Sock size must be specified when registering. Children’s races have a different gift. After a weather-related cancellation, a replacement date of 08.02.2026 was set. Registrations remain valid; if participants cannot attend, the entry fee may be refunded. Dates in various locations, registration with sock size, weather-related date change, series standings, WhatsApp channel

name: Limes- Winterlaufserie - 1. Lauf über 10 km
description: The Limes Winter Running Series is a three-part winter running series in Pohlheim. The first race, a 10 km run, forms the basis for the overall standings. The series attracts runners from the region, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district, and has a long tradition, with its 49th edition taking place in 2026. The race offers a great opportunity to compete with other runners during the colder months and kick off the winter running series.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Pohlheim, Watzenborn-Steinberg
Part of a three-race winter running series
Popular race with regional participation, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, usually rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Please check the details with the organizer before registering. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a wintry atmosphere. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and also provides results and participant lists.

name: Pokallauf
description: The “Rund um Marienberg” Cup Race is a traditional running event held in the Marienberg region. Competitions are held in classic and freestyle technique, with distances of 5 km and 10 km, each run on a 2.5 km loop. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels a sporting challenge in a scenic setting. Due to the current snow conditions, technical and course adjustments may affect how the competition is run.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances on a 2.5 km loop
Classic technique for U6–U9; freestyle technique from U10
New 10 km distance from H21
additional: The event is organized by ATSV Gebirge/Gelobtland e.V. The event announcement will not be updated. Competition technique depends on age group: U6–U9 use classic technique with a mass start; U10 and older use freestyle technique with a mass start. Depending on snow conditions, the route may vary, with adjustments to technique and distance. It is a popular event for runners seeking nature and a challenge.

name: Rülzheimer Crosslauf
description: The Rülzheim Cross Country Run, organized by LG Rülzheim, takes place on November 7, 2026, at Peter-Becht-Stadion in Rülzheim. The event offers two distances, 1.1 km and 8.4 km, on a compact cross-country course within the stadium grounds and neighboring areas. Unlike road races, the course crosses varied terrain and features new obstacles introduced by organizer Otto Pfadt. The run is part of a series of events organized by LG Rülzheim, including the Südpfalz Runs near the Moby Dick leisure center.
course_highlights: Compact cross-country course in the stadium and neighboring areas
New obstacles on the course
November event, with typically cool and rainy weather
additional: The start is at Peter-Becht-Stadion in Rülzheim. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. This is not a road race but a cross-country run with obstacles. The race takes place within the stadium grounds; obstacles are present, and weather-dependent conditions may be possible in November. Ask on site for details.

name: SCC Cross Country
description: The SCC Cross Country is a forest race in Berlin at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage in Westend. Two clearly defined cross-country routes are offered: 4 km for U16 through adults and 9 km for U18 through adults; both races start in the morning. The event is deliberately straightforward and is aimed at club runners, young athletes and adults who want to run short off-road loops, setting it apart from the city’s major road races. The course follows paved and unpaved forest paths, where rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish matter more than scenic views. Awards go to the top three in each age and gender category, and there is a prize for the fastest final lap for men and women.
course_highlights: Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths
Two routes: 4 km for U16 through adults, 9 km for U18 through adults
Focus on rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish
additional: Entry is free for SCC members. Late registration is available shortly before the start for an additional fee. An archive of results is available to document the race. The event takes place at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage on Harbigstraße in Westend, Berlin-Charlottenburg. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths, entry fee for non-members, late registration for an additional fee, November weather around 7 °C, rainy.

name: Schkölener Stadtparklauf
description: The Schkölen Stadtparklauf is a long-standing running event in Schkölen, Thuringia, taking place on November 7, 2026. Organized by TSV 1885 Schkölen and SSV Friedrich-Schiller-Gymnasium Eisenberg, the event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and young adults. The routes run through the town park and include short and long loops, combined according to age group. The event emphasizes clear age-group divisions and is aimed particularly at young runners.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.6 km to 5 km, tailored to age groups
Loops through the town park, combining short and long loops
Age groups determined by calendar year for fair competitions
additional: Age groups are determined by calendar year; for example, a 6-year-old runner in 2025 belongs to age group 6. Participants are asked to enter the correct age group when registering late. Various running distances, age-group divisions, registration with the correct age, looped running on the sports field

name: Sparkassen-LüneCross
description: The Sparkassen-LüneCross is an exciting and challenging cross-country running event set amid nature and the city of Lüneburg. The varied course follows sandy, root-covered trails, meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks, testing endurance, strength and running technique. Main races are offered over 4 km and 8 km, along with shorter distances for children and young people and 8 km relay races. Alongside the sporting challenge, the focus is on the enjoyment of running and community, with a school competition and a convivial awards ceremony afterwards.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with sandy, root-covered trails
Routes through meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks
8 km relay races can be run by teams of 3 to 6 runners
additional: There is a school competition with prizes for schools with the highest participation rate. Food and refreshments are available, followed by an awards ceremony and a convivial get-together. Relay teams of 3 to 6 runners can be formed from family, colleagues, teammates or friends. The route passes through natural surroundings, including forest paths, meadows, sand and gravel. Registration is required; family and group participation is possible.

name: TSV Bayer 04 Talent- und Speed-Cross
description: The TSV Bayer 04 Talent and Speed Cross in Leverkusen is an established cross-country race, serving in particular as a talent scout event for school-age categories up to U16, as well as for the U18 and older age groups. The event is a regular fixture on the Nordrhein Cross Cup calendar and features a varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage. With a tight schedule and exciting races, including cross sprints, it offers an engaging experience for both participants and spectators. The event is attracting growing numbers of participants and is accompanied by good catering and professional commentary.
course_highlights: Varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage
Part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup for age groups M/W 11 to 15
Exciting cross sprints, particularly in the U18 category
additional: The event saw an increase of almost 200 participants. Good catering and professional commentary are provided. The races follow one another in a tight schedule. Dates in November 2026; cross-country race as part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup; various age groups; competition on unpaved terrain.

name: Westerwinkellauf
location: Wasserschloss Westerwinkel, Ascheberg-Herbern, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Westerwinkellauf is a traditional fun run around Westerwinkel moated castle in Ascheberg-Herbern. The course runs mainly along park paths and offers scenic surroundings. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and uses modern Race Result timing. The start and finish areas are at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern. Local partners provide refreshments, and professional commentary helps create a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course runs mainly along park paths around Westerwinkel moated castle
Start and finish at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern
Scenic running surroundings with good facilities
additional: Timing is provided by Race Result using a disposable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. No refunds for non-participation. Parking is available in the schoolyard of Mariengrundschule. Commentary by Janik Broszeit from Dortmund. Refreshments for participants and spectators provided by Getränke Zimmermann. Courses, start times, site map, registration, results, certificates, running and walking categories, participation for school groups, free participation for registered pupils.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a traditional running event that has been held in Rodgau since 1980, attracting recreational runners as well as top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series features four race dates, each with 5 km and 10 km routes through the Jügesheim Forest, described as fast and flat. The event takes place at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim and offers team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The organization receives high praise, and there is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area. Timing is handled with a bib chip.
course_highlights: A flat, fast route through the Jügesheim Forest
Event held at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim
Team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams
additional: Start times: 5 km at 14:00, 10 km at 15:00. Chip timing using a bib chip (gun-time recording). The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Club members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering by email. Payment is in cash on site. There is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area (covered). The route is very popular for personal bests. The event takes place on four Saturdays: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with chip timing and refreshments at the stadium. Teams of three are possible. The event is also geared toward winter training, with training plans provided.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain in the western forests of Augsburg and require good fitness and health. The event offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December and are a popular series for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Course distances of approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
additional: Race numbers are distributed in the start/finish area each time. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße car park (races 1–3), and there is space to leave a change of clothes or luggage in a tent or pavilion (at your own risk). Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the fourth race also offers mulled wine and children’s punch. The overall awards ceremony takes place at the forest hut after the fourth race. Parking is available in Bergheim, on Kathreinerstraße and on surrounding streets, but not at the Bergheim sports clubhouse. Races take place in November, with distances ranging from approximately 2.8 km to 9.9 km. The meeting point is usually by the forest car park near Kathreinerstrasse and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim. November weather can be cool and rainy.

location: Wysowa-Zdroju, Powiat Gorlicki, Województwo Małopolskie, Poland

tiers.description: 60 zł brutto płatne przelewem w terminie do 30.06.2026 r.

description: Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the scenic surroundings of Radocyna and Magura Małastowska in the Low Beskids. The event offers three distances: 7.6 km, 23.9 km, and a 2.3 km Vertical race with significant elevation gain. It attracts both amateurs and elite runners, offering a unique atmosphere and cash prizes. The participant limit is 400, and the start and finish are located at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna” and Magura Ski Park. This is the event’s eleventh edition, combining sporting competition with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 24 km course with 610 m of elevation gain
7 km course with 160 m of elevation gain
2.3 km Vertical with 340 m of elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limit: 400 (150 for 7 km, 250 for 24 km). Start and finish at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna.” Race office open from 7:45 to 10:00. The time limit for the 24 km race is 5 hours. Runners must attach their bibs to the front of their shirt or shorts. Participants with a Rate My Trail ranking of 730 points or higher may enter free of charge. The courses include mountain trails and muddy sections, and the start is scheduled for 10:30. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced trail runners.

name: 20 Gminne Biegi z okazji Święta Niepodległości
Kováčovská desiatka
location: Kováčová, Zvolen District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka je tradiční závod na 10 kilometrů, který se koná v Žandově v Libereckém kraji. Akce je součástí Okresní běžecké ligy Českolipsko a vítá běžce všech věkových kategorií. Trať vede po silnici i v terénu, což nabízí pestré prostředí pro závodníky. Závod je oblíbenou událostí regionální běžecké komunity a přináší příležitost k osobním výkonům i setkání s běžeckými nadšenci.
course_highlights: Trať vede po silnici i v terénu
Součást regionální běžecké ligy Českolipsko
Vhodný pro všechny věkové kategorie
additional: Závod se koná v listopadu 2026, registrace a další podrobnosti nejsou specifikovány, akce je součástí širšího seriálu regionálních běhů.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Dobřichovický běh je součástí Brdského běžeckého poháru a nabízí běžcům trať dlouhou přibližně 6 km. Závod startuje na škvárovém stadionu TJ Sokol Dobřichovice a vede po polních cestách, což zaručuje příjemný terén pro běh. Akce je vhodná jak pro dospělé, tak i pro děti, které mají své vlastní závody. Start hlavního závodu je v 13:00 a pořadatelem je ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Délka trati cca 6 km
Start na škvárovém stadionu TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
Trať vede po polních cestách
additional: Místo startu: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. Trať je měřena GPS na 5.72 km, dle propozic uváděna jako 6 km. Závod je součástí Brdského běžeckého poháru, který zahrnuje i dětské závody. Povrch trati je kombinací škvárového stadionu a polních cest. Trať zahrnuje škvárový stadion a polní cesty; možnost registrace online; závody jsou vhodné pro všechny věkové kategorie.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Velká kunratická je jeden z nejstarších běžeckých závodů v Čechách, který se koná každoročně druhou listopadovou neděli v Kunratickém lese v Praze. Závod se běží nepřetržitě od roku 1934 a je známý svým náročným profilem a proměnlivým počasím, které přispívá k jeho unikátní atmosféře. Účastní se ho široké spektrum běžců od malých dětí až po veterány, kteří soutěží na šesti tratích o délce od 370 do 3100 metrů. Pořadatelem je atletický klub Spartak Praha 4.
course_highlights: Náročný profil tratí v Kunratickém lese
Šest tratí od 370 m do 3100 m
Intervalový start po dvojicích s 10 sekundovým odstupem
additional: Všechny kategorie startují po dvojicích s intervalem 10 sekund. Oficiální trika značky BUSHMAN lze zakoupit výhradně během registrace. Vyzvednutí objednaných triček probíhá ve stanu na hrázi. Celkový počet účastníků je omezen na 3600, počet běžců přes Hrádek na 2700. Změny v registraci jsou možné do 14. 10. 2026 mailem, poté jen při prezentaci. Závod se koná v listopadu, omezený počet účastníků na 3400, registrace online od 5. října 2026, možnost registrace na místě, různé věkové a výkonnostní kategorie

name: Krumlovská 11
location: Hornobránský rybník, Český Krumlov, Czech Republic

description: Krumlovská 11 je svatomartinský dobročinný běh konaný 8. listopadu 2026 u Hornobránského rybníka v Českém Krumlově. Nabízí hlavní běh na přibližně 11 km pro běžce od 15 let, rodinný běh pro děti od 2 do 15 let a štafetové běhy. Trasa vede krásnou přírodou přes Křížovou horu a Přídolí. Akce podporuje sociální službu Osobní asistence, která pomáhá dětem se zdravotním postižením a seniorům v regionu. Součástí je i bohatý doprovodný program a možnost zakoupení běžeckých triček.
course_highlights: Hlavní trasa cca 11 km přes Křížovou horu a Přídolí
Rodinný běh 1-2 km dle věkové kategorie
Štafetový běh 2x 5,5 km s předávkou u hornobránského rybníku
additional: Start hlavního běhu a štafet je v 12:11, rodinný běh začíná od 10:01 s časovými odstupy kategorií. Kapacita hlavního běhu je 200 běžců, kapacita rodinného běhu 200 dětí. Balíček se startovním číslem je možné vyzvednout od 8:45 do 11:30 na místě konání. Možnost zakoupení běžeckých triček a martinské husy (za příplatek). Štafety mohou být ženské, mužské, smíšené i firemní. Akce je dobročinná, výtěžek jde na podporu sociální služby Osobní asistence v Českém Krumlově. Start i cíl jsou u Hornobránského rybníka; hlavní běh startuje od 12:11. Online registrace je otevřena do 30. října 2026 a je povinná. Kapacita závodu je 200 účastníků.

name: Birkhahnlauf
location: Schneeren, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Birkhahnlauf in Schneeren is a traditional race that has been held annually on the last Sunday in October for over 50 years. The event offers distances for all age groups, from short children’s races starting at 500 metres to challenging 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The routes run through the pine forest on firm forest paths with a slightly sandy surface and no significant elevation gain, making the race a special experience surrounded by nature. New this year is a 2.3 km distance for age group U12 and above. The friendly atmosphere and promptly held award ceremonies with certificates and medals round off the event.
course_highlights: Routes through the pine forest on firm forest paths
Distances from 500 m to 10.2 km for all age groups
Kilometre markers on the 5.1 km and 10.2 km routes, with no significant elevation gain
additional: Start times: children’s 500 m at 10:30, 1,000 m at 10:45, 2.3 km at 11:10, and 5.1 km and 10.2 km at 11:40. Award ceremonies take place promptly after the respective races. Parking is available nearby and signposted. Online registration is preferred from 01.08.2026; the entry fee must be paid on site no later than 20 minutes before the race starts. Forest race, distances from 0.5 km to 10 km, children’s races, online registration from 01.08.2026, start on 25.10.2026

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Winter Running Series 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series connected with the traditional Rund um Wellen event. It is organized by the local running club, which also runs the historic Wellen Marathon, one of the oldest marathons in Germany. The event offers a welcoming, family atmosphere, various distance options, and strong local support from volunteers, sponsors, and the local fire brigade. The organizers aim to preserve the event’s well-established challenge and familiar character.
course_highlights: Part of the long-standing Rund um Wellen event, with four distances
Rural, family-friendly atmosphere, organized by a local club
Strong local support from volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather: average 7 °C (minimum 2 °C) with frequent rain (45 mm of precipitation). Start location: Beverstedt-Wellen. Terrain: mixed. Registration: not specified. Further notes: Part of the Rund um Wellen event, with local support and volunteers involved.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races follow gravel and partially paved paths, where snow and ice may be present, underscoring the winter character of the event. The series offers various distances from 5 km to 20 km and is open to recreational runners of all age groups. All runners are welcome; club membership is not required. Times are recorded electronically, and there is a cup classification for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Route around Dutzendteich and Silbersee
Gravel and partially paved paths
Possible icy and snowy conditions on the course
additional: The Winter Running Series consists of three races, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km spread across three dates. To qualify for the cup classification, you must register for all three races. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. Refreshments are available in the start/finish area. The course may change due to official orders. Routes around Dutzendteich and Silbersee; snow and ice possible; accompanying others on sports equipment is not permitted; aids such as inline skates are not permitted; start times between November 2025 and February 2026.

name: 50. Hermann-Löns-Park-Lauf
location: Hermann-Löns-Park, Hannover-Wülferode, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hermann-Löns-Park Run in Hannover-Kirchrode is a traditional road and fun run held annually in early November. The event offers various distances from 400 m to 10 km, officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, volunteer support, and professional timekeeping. Runners can enjoy a raffle and refreshments in the finish area, making it a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in accordance with German Athletics Association standards
Run through Hermann-Löns-Park in Hannover-Kirchrode
Various distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on site on Saturday from 14:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday from 9:00 until 45 minutes before the start. Race numbers can be collected on both days. Electronic timekeeping is used, with results recorded via race number. Spikes are not allowed and may lead to disqualification. The event takes place in all weather conditions. A €2 deposit for the race number is payable at registration. Courses from 1.5 km to 10 km, marathon relay, registration and results online

name: Bibersfelder Herbstlauf
description: The Bibersfeld Autumn Run is part of the "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir" running series and offers suitable routes for runners of all ages. The event features varied courses, with the classic 10-kilometer run at its heart. Participants can look forward to a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, and both individual runners and teams are welcome. All finishers receive certificates and gifts, while younger runners also receive medals. Registration is online only, and late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Classic 10-kilometer run
Family-friendly event with routes for all ages
Part of the regional "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir" running series
additional: Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start. Certificates are provided digitally and can be printed at the venue or conveniently at home. The Cup Quartet awards ceremony takes place after the fourth race in Bibersfeld, from approximately 14:00. Various running and walking distances, online-only registration, certificates can be printed at the venue or at home, including a 10-kilometer run and a half marathon.

name: Braunschweiger Speed5
description: Braunschweiger Speed5 is the fastest fun run in the city of Braunschweig, organised by Polizeisportverein Braunschweig and Braunschweiger Laufclub. The running event on November 8, 2026, offers exciting races for recreational and competitive runners of all ages, including an 800 m children’s race, a 1-mile schoolchildren’s race and a measured 5 km race. The event features professional chip timing, a clear cutoff time for the fast 5 km race, and a friendly atmosphere with refreshments at the finish and music. Awards ceremonies recognise the top female and male runners in various age groups and main races.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course with a 22-minute cutoff in the fast race
800 m children’s race and 1-mile schoolchildren’s race
Professional chip timing and awards for top finishers
additional: Race bib collection starts at 09:15 on the grounds of Polizeisportverein. Refreshments are available for runners at the finish, with musical entertainment by DJ Carlito. Paramedics will be on site for safety. A pacemaker will be available in the slower 5 km race to help runners achieve times under 20 minutes. Certificates can be accessed online or on site after the race. Course: measured 5 km, children’s and schoolchildren’s races. Registration via RaceResults. Parking is available along Georg-Westermann-Allee and Ebertallee. The event takes place in Prinzenpark.

name: Friesenheimer Eulenlauf
description: The Friesenheim Owl Run returns on November 8, 2026, after a six-year break. It is organised by SVF Ludwigshafen 1898 / 1946 e.V. Events include the classic 10 km race, a schoolchildren’s race, a 400 m toddlers’ race, and a new 3 km course for beginners and those trying running, which is also used for the schoolchildren’s race. The event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels and takes place on the club grounds in Ludwigshafen-Friesenheim. The organisers look forward to welcoming many participants and to the support of the local community.
course_highlights: Classic 10 km course
Schoolchildren’s race and 400 m toddlers’ race
New 3 km course for beginners and those trying running
additional: The schoolchildren’s race takes place on the 3 km course. Registration is via br-timing. The event is held by SVF Ludwigshafen 1898 / 1946 e.V. on the club grounds at Teichgasse 31, 67063 Ludwigshafen am Rhein. Registration is open until November 6, 2026; late entries are available for a fee. Courses are measured. Rainy weather is possible in November.

name: Hohen Neuendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Hohen Neuendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event that has been held in Hohen Neuendorf since 1900 and is considered the birthplace of cross-country running in Germany. The run attracts numerous participants from the region and beyond each year and offers distances for all age groups, from a children’s run to longer distances. The event brings generations together and is supported by many volunteers and local partners. It traditionally takes place in November and is a fixture on the regional sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country run with a history dating back to 1900
Participants spanning generations, from age 3 to over 90
Support from local clubs and reservists along the course
additional: The run includes various distances, including a 400-metre children’s run and a 5.5 km course. The event is supported by many volunteers, including the Roter Adler Reservists from Lehnitz. The Autumn Run is one of the largest running events in the Oberhavel district and attracts participants from various regions. It takes place at the Rudolf Harbig sports ground and is weather-dependent. Registration is via MyRacepartner. The event is known for its historical significance in cross-country running in Germany and promotes a sense of community through sport.

name: int. Hohenzollern Berglauf
description: The International Hohenzollern Hill Run is a long-established hill race organised by Ski-Club Hechingen e.V. The challenging course leads from Hechingen’s Weiherstadion up to Hohenzollern Castle and puts runners to the test. The race attracts both beginners and experienced hill-running specialists, and delights participants with a special atmosphere featuring music and cheering along the course. With more than 70 volunteers and a large field of participants, the race is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Start at Hechingen’s Weiherstadion
Challenging climb from kilometre 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle
Music and atmosphere along the course (Runner’s Dixxies at km 3, Schnorchelhuaschter at km 5.5)
additional: The race is organised by Ski-Club Hechingen with more than 70 volunteers. The course starts out flatter and becomes increasingly steep from kilometre 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle. The event offers a special atmosphere, with live rock music at the start and music and cheering along the course. Participants range from beginners to experienced hill runners; some have been taking part for more than 30 years. Registration until 5 November 2025, shuttle service to the castle, and a supporting programme with an awards ceremony.

name: Int. Martinslauf
description: The International Martinslauf in Losheim am See is a popular fun run held annually in the village center and at the Losheim Reservoir. The event attracts up to 1,500 runners and offers 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km courses that take runners through scenic surroundings around the reservoir. Runners can register late until shortly before the start, making the race appealing to last-minute entrants. The Martinslauf is a fixture in Saarland and is organized by TV 1929 Losheim e.V.
course_highlights: Courses around the Losheim Reservoir
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Start and finish in the center of Losheim
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before each start. Parking is available at several locations in the center of Losheim. With up to 1,500 participants, the event is one of the largest fun runs in Saarland. Courses around the reservoir, relay and individual races, online registration, parking in Losheim, running events in June, April, September 2024, 2025, 2026

name: Karlsbader Volkslauf
description: The Karlsbad Volkslauf is a long-standing running event that has been a fixture on many runners’ calendars for more than three decades. It offers several races, including the 10 km main race, a 2 km Sparkasse school run, and a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants. Despite changeable weather, the event attracts many participants and is known for its excellent organization and family-friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Karlsbad-Langensteinbach and offers an appealing running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on a challenging course
2 km Sparkasse school run for young runners
400 m Bambini run, introduced for the first time the previous year
additional: Alongside the main race, the Volkslauf includes races for children and teenagers. The event is known for its excellent organization and regularly attracts more than 200 finishers. The mayor and local representatives praise the event, which draws many participants even in the rain. It features races for children and teenagers as well as various distances for all age groups. The event takes place in all weather and is very popular with participants.

name: Lauf am Lech - 2. Lauf der Jedermannserie
description: The Lauf am Lech is the second race in the Jedermann series by LG Donau-Ries, an autumn running series in the Donau-Ries region of Bavaria. The race takes place at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain and offers 3 km and 10 km courses. The series caters to both recreational and experienced runners and moves from town to town, with each race held at a different venue. Race numbers are equipped with transponders and must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Online pre-registration is recommended to avoid waiting on race day.
course_highlights: Start at Georg-Weber-Stadion in Rain
3 km and 10 km course distances
Part of a multi-race series through different towns in Donau-Ries
additional: Race numbers with transponders; collection at least 20 minutes before the start; online pre-registration recommended to avoid queues on race day. Participants can pre-register online; the series visits several towns in the region; November weather is usually rainy.

name: Lauf der 39. Crosslauf-Serie 2026 Cochem-Zell in Kaisersesch
description: The 3rd race of the 39th 2026 Cross-Country Series in Kaisersesch takes place at the Waldsportplatz in the Eifel and offers distances for Bambini, schoolchildren, recreational runners and adults. Distances range from 300 m for the youngest participants to 8.2 km in the main race for U20 and older participants. The course runs around Kaisersesch, with children and young people running a slightly modified loop. The race is part of the Cochem-Zell Crosslauf Series, where participants earn points toward the overall standings and can compete for the district championship title. The event is organised by the local athletics club, with volunteers helping with refreshments and event organisation.
course_highlights: Course runs around Kaisersesch
Modified loops for children and young people
Part of the Cochem-Zell Crosslauf Series, with overall standings
additional: The race is organised by the local athletics club, with volunteers helping with cake donations, sales and the start-finish area. At one of the most recent editions, 145 participants took part across all distances. Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C and rainy days, is to be expected. Distances range from 300 m for the youngest participants to 8.2 km for the main race; the event is rooted in the Cochem-Zell region and takes place in typical November weather.

name: Lauf Rund um den Höglwörther See
description: The Run Around Höglwörther See is a traditional race in Teisendorf, featuring a scenic route around Lake Höglwörth. The event offers several distances, including a 13 km race, a 4.2 km charity run, and Bambini and kids’ races. The atmosphere is shaped by a strong sense of community, live music, and excellent refreshments at the finish. The event also supports regional fundraising projects and fosters team spirit through team rankings.
course_highlights: 13 km route around Lake Höglwörther See through picturesque scenery
4.2 km charity run on a loop around the outskirts of Teisendorf
Bambini and kids’ races on child-friendly routes in the town centre
additional: Race-number collection from 08:30 in the Teisendorf sports hall, near the start and finish. Timing is done using a disposable transponder attached to the race number. There is a refreshment station along the route and a free refreshment stand at the finish with tea, coffee, water, fruit, and cake. Live music along the route and a DJ/announcer at the finish. Team ranking for clubs and companies, with special prizes and a brewery tour for the winning team. Late entries are possible on race day until 11:00 (for an additional fee). Terrain/charity run/community event, distances of 4.2 km and 13 km, start at the Teisendorf sports hall

name: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh
location: Wildenloh bei Oldenburg, Landkreis Oldenburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh is a traditional cross-country run held in early November on the beautiful fitness trail in Wildenloh, west of Oldenburg. The name means “Run across Wildenloh” and reflects the event’s rustic character: it takes place in the forest, without showers. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V., which creates a friendly, nature-oriented running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the local fitness trail in Wildenloh
Rustic forest course without showers
Traditional event with regional character
additional: The run takes place on a rustic forest course without showers. Several distances are offered (short course: 1600m, middle course: 3200m), and results from previous years are available. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V. The run is held annually in November. There are no showers on site, results are published, and categories include children and adults.

name: Martinslauf
location: Unterbacher See, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: SFD '75 e. V., pulsschlag, SC Grün Weiß Paderborn, Friedrich-Rister-Gedächtnislauf
description: The Martinslauf is being organized for the 48th time by SFD '75 e. V. around Unterbacher See in Düsseldorf. The event offers a variety of races for all age groups, including Bambini and youth races, an inclusion run, and Nordic walking. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and varied course, offering both sporting challenges and fun for the whole family. Award ceremonies for various age groups take place after the races, and participants can purchase a personalized finisher medal.
course_highlights: Loop course around Unterbacher See
A range of distances from 150 m to 10 km
Start and finish at Strandbad Süd on Unterbacher See
additional: Race packets can be mailed (for an additional fee of 4 EUR) or collected on site. Late registration is possible for a 3 EUR fee. Timing is done with a chip integrated into the race bib; there is no rental fee. Showers are available at the neighboring campsite. Free parking is available at Strandbad Süd and Strandbad Nord. A finisher medal engraved with the participant’s name and time can be ordered for 13 EUR and will be handed out on race day. The 10 km race cutoff is 13:15; the event ends at approximately 14:00. The Martinslauf combines fun runs, family events, and evening light runs, with a focus on running for fun, community, and a special atmosphere. Participation is at the participant’s own risk, with various race distances and activities for children and adults.

name: Obersulmer Volkslauf
description: The Obersulm Fun Run takes place on November 8, 2026, around Lake Breitenau and offers runners of all ages an appealing running experience. The event includes various distances, such as the 10 km main race, the 5 km fun run, and walking and Nordic walking routes. The course is scenically attractive, with moderate elevation changes, and is accompanied by enthusiastic spectators. Its friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the fun run a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Breitenau
5 km course with a starting elevation of 227 m and an elevation of 233 m
Attractive course with gravel and crushed-stone surfaces
additional: Professional timing using a transponder in the race bib. Bib must be worn on the front. Medals for Bambinis and schoolchildren at the finish. Award ceremonies take place immediately after the races at the Bauhof grounds. The top three finishers in the fun run, main race, and walking/Nordic walking events receive a wine gift. Free parking directly at Lake Breitenau. The course follows an attractive loop over gravel and crushed-stone surfaces. Course profile: 5 km and 10 km laps; refreshments along the course; food and drink provided by the lakeside kiosk; medical services provided by the German Red Cross; free parking at the lake; event takes place in all weather; personal data will be used in accordance with data protection regulations.

name: Quickborn Run über 5 km und 10 km
description: The Quickborn Run is organized by TuS Holstein Quickborn and will be held for the 47th time in 2026. There are two race distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting in Quickborn on November 8. Childcare is available for families with young children, allowing parents to take part as well. The event offers changing facilities, free parking and a free timing chip on loan. The races are open to young people aged 12 and 14 and up, respectively, and follow the rules of the German Athletics Regulations.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km race routes
Start and finish at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn
Free timing chip on loan
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. for the 5 km race, 11:00 a.m. for the 10 km race. Race pack collection from 8:00 to 10:30 a.m. at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium. Changing facilities in the sports hall. Free parking at the sports hall and in the AKN station parking garage. Participation from age 12 for the 5 km and age 14 for the 10 km. Registration opens on 1.7.2026 via the Race Result portal. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, but participant numbers are limited, particularly for the 5 km race. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; minimum ages: 12 for the 5 km and 14 for the 10 km; limited places; parking at the sports hall and AKN station parking garage.

name: Refrather Herbstlauf
location: Königsforst, Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Refrath Autumn Run is a long-standing running classic in the Königsforst near Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, held annually since 1986. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings. The courses run through the autumn forest and feature out-and-back routes with challenging yet scenic sections. The race attracts both competitive runners and those running for enjoyment, and concludes with prompt award ceremonies for all age groups.
course_highlights: Out-and-back routes through the autumnal Königsforst
DLV-measured courses over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon
Scenic forest trails with challenging sections
additional: Start times: 5 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00, half marathon at 12:30. Award ceremonies take place promptly after runners finish. Parking is available on Rather Weg, approximately 1.2 km from the Bensberg exit of the A4. Public transport: take KVB line 1 to “Refrath”. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings. Participants can register online. The courses are gently undulating, with an elevation difference of about 6 m in the 5 km race and 20 m in the 10 km race. The event has been a fixture on the region’s running calendar for many years.

name: Rursee-Marathon
description: The Rursee Marathon takes place on 8 November 2026 in Simmerath-Einruhr and offers runners a unique nature experience in the Eifel National Park. The marathon course follows a hilly loop along the Obersee, Urftsee and Rursee lakes, with beautiful autumn scenery and varied landscapes. In addition to the marathon, other events include a 52 km ultra run, a 16.5 km run, a 5 km run and children’s races. The event is known for its challenging course and picturesque surroundings, making every run a special experience.
course_highlights: Hilly loop along the Obersee, Urftsee and Rursee lakes
Route through wooded areas with beautiful autumn scenery
Full circuit of the Rursee, including challenging sections and 370 metres of elevation gain
additional: The marathon starts at 10:30 on 08.11.2026. The course is 70% unpaved field and forest paths and 30% asphalt. There are 7 refreshment points plus refreshments at the finish. Other weekend events: 5 km run on 07.11.2026 at 15:30, 52 km ultra run on 08.11.2026 at 09:00 (cut-off time 16:30), children’s races and Nordic walking. The event offers clear wayfinding on race day and is part of the Eifel Cup. Multiple running events, online registration, event photography, early-bird discounts until the end of August, and late-entry fees of up to 5 euros.

name: RWW-Herbstwaldlauf
description: The RWW Herbstwaldlauf in Bottrop is a traditional race taking place on November 8, 2026. It is part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup and offers various distances for beginners and experienced runners. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, where the Herbstwaldlauf tradition dates back to 1973. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge amid picturesque woodland scenery, bringing together community and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Run through Bottrop’s picturesque woodland scenery
Start and finish at the historic Jahnstadion
Part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup
additional: The time limit for all races is 15:30. A human broom wagon is available to support participants. T-shirts can be ordered in advance. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, which is also used by the Adler-Langlauf Bottrop training groups. Held in November, the race includes routes through forests and natural surroundings and offers a welcoming club atmosphere for runners of all levels.

name: Steinheimer Geologenlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist Online bis Mittwoch, 05. November 2025, 20:00 Uhr möglich (incl. personifizierte StartNr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist Online bis Mittwoch, 05. November 2025, 20:00 Uhr möglich (incl. personifizierte StartNr)

description: The Steinheim Geologenlauf is a long-standing running event that has been held in the beautiful Steinheim Basin for over 35 years. The main course is 10 km long, mostly paved, with two small climbs, and offers an appealing challenge for both competitive runners and beginners. The program also includes a 5 km fitness run, a team run, walking, and children’s races, suitable for all age and ability groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, dedicated team of volunteers, and good refreshments at the club center.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mostly paved, with two small climbs at 3.2 km and 6.4 km
5 km fitness run, extremely flat and well suited to beginner runners
Start and finish at the club center in Steinheim am Albuch
additional: Late registration is available online after advance registration closes and in person on the event day until 60 minutes before the respective start, but without a personalized race bib. Changing facilities and showers are available at the club center. Refreshments include cake and grilled sausages in the outdoor area. The three fastest women and men in each age group will be honored. Various running disciplines, online registration, results, and photo galleries available; event held in November.

name: Süderelbe Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
price_range: 20 Euro Halbmarathon, 18 Euro 10 km, 5 Euro Kinderlauf
description: The 50th Süderelbe Half Marathon through the Altes Land takes place on November 8, 2026. The course starts at the CU Arena at Neugraben S-Bahn station, runs through the Altes Land to Neuenfelde, and returns to the start. In addition to the half marathon, there are 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The event is organized by Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V. and offers a varied program for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the CU Arena, Neugraben S-Bahn station
Course through the scenic Altes Land to Neuenfelde
Return to the starting point along the same route
additional: The program includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The organizer is Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V., with office hours Mon–Fri 09:00–11:00 and Mon–Thu 16:00–18:00. The event features a course through the Altes Land, various race distances, a children’s race, a walking event, a course closing time of 12:30, parking at the P+R car park at Neugraben S-Bahn station, race-number pickup on the day of the event, refreshments along the course, and medals and certificates for participants.

name: Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf
description: The Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf is a challenging trail race in November that starts and finishes at Haus Blume in Wernigerode. The route takes runners to the Kaiserturm and offers a varied challenge, with narrow forest paths, muddy sections and steep climbs. In addition to the main races over 5.4 km and 10 km, there are also children’s races over 1 km and 2.1 km. The event is organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V. Wernigerode and, with around 160 participants, is a popular local tradition that also includes a pasta party on the evening before the race.
course_highlights: Trail race on narrow forest paths
Steep climbs to the Kaiserturm
Muddy and fast downhill sections
additional: The event has four distances: 1 km and 2.1 km for children, and 5.4 km and 10 km for the main races, which start together later in the morning. A pasta party on the evening before the race is a small local tradition. Trail character with challenging climbs; registration by email; pasta party on Saturday evening at Waldgasthaus Armeleuteberg.

name: Westfalenparklauf
location: Westfalenpark Dortmund, Dortmund, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Lauftreff Bittermark Dortmund, LT Bittermark Dortmund, Dortmunder Volksbank

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Onlineanmeldung bis 27.10.2026, 23:59 Uhr zum regulären Beitrag

description: The Dortmunder Volksbank Westfalenparklauf on 8 November 2026 is a sporting competition in Westfalenpark Dortmund, welcoming runners of all ages. The event offers various distances, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and main races over 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with electronic timing. The course is measured by the DLV and runs through the beautiful Westfalenpark. All finishers receive medals, and the fastest runners are honored. The event prioritizes safe and fair race operations, with medical support and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Course in Westfalenpark Dortmund, with start and finish at the Ruhrallee entrance
DLV-measured courses over 2.5 km (1 lap), 5 km (2 laps) and 10 km (4 laps)
Electronic timing and lead bicycle for the main races
additional: Race number distribution is available on race day until 45 minutes before each start. There are no changing facilities, but baggage storage is available without liability. Headphones, dogs and strollers are not allowed. The Bambini race is untimed; participants receive a certificate only. Awards go to places 1–3 in the men’s and women’s categories for the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as to age-group winners. Medical support is available on the course and in the start/finish area. A lead bicycle accompanies the 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races. This is a local event with a traditional character, including medals for finishers, online registration and medical support on the course. Certain participation rules apply, including a ban on dogs and umbrellas.

name: Winter Crosslaufserie 2026/27 / 1.Termin
description: The 2026/27 Winter Cross-Country Series in Goldbach, Lower Franconia, offers runners a challenging winter race series with several dates. The races take place on varied cross-country courses through the winter landscape and are suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The established series promotes the enjoyment of winter running in the region and offers a great opportunity for competition and community.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses through the winter landscape
Challenging course layout with natural obstacles
Running enjoyment for competitive and recreational runners
additional: Dates and details of the series are available on the website; terrain details are not specified.

name: 3TuermeWEG TRAILRUN
location: Hagen Stadtwald, Hagen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3TürmeWEG Trailrun is a timed trail race organized by TV Hasperbach 1898 e.V. in cooperation with Hagen.Wirtschaftsentwicklung. The route runs through Hagen City Forest and follows the well-known 3TürmeWEG premium hiking trail. Along the way, runners pass three historic towers and a fallow deer enclosure and enjoy numerous views. The route has been evaluated by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA) and is part of the National League 2026. A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place every year in August.
course_highlights: The route passes three historic towers counterclockwise: Kaiser-Friedrich-Turm, Bismarckturm, Eugen-Richter-Turm
Runs through Hagen City Forest, with a fallow deer enclosure and numerous viewpoints
Evaluated by ITRA and part of the National League 2026
additional: Limited-edition 3TT short-sleeved and long-sleeved technical shirts, as well as padded 3TT Skyrunner running socks, can optionally be ordered by 30.09.2026. A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place on the third Thursday of every August. The route is available as a GPX file for running independently. The event offers a varied route with cultural sights, optional merchandise available to pre-order, and starts on 8 November 2026. Registration opens on 1 July 2026.

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: The TuS Jaderberg Winter Running and Walking Series is a popular event held annually in Jaderberg. The first part of the series takes place in November and gives runners and walkers the opportunity to enjoy some friendly sporting competition. The event is known for its winter atmosphere and the support of TuS Jaderberg, which organizes the series. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Winter running and walking routes
A shared community experience
Part of a popular series in Jaderberg
