additional: The first part of the series takes place on November 22, 2026. The event promotes sporting activities in the community.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Race packs can be collected using an authorization form template. Cross-country race, event in Marceliński Forest, November 8, 2026, puzzle-piece medals, forest routes

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
description: The Strážske Liberation Run is a traditional race held to mark the anniversary of the city’s liberation. This sporting celebration attracts runners of different age groups, including youth and adults, who compete over various distances. The event is organized by the City of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club and is known for its long history and strong community spirit. Runners can enjoy the city’s atmosphere while testing their abilities in a friendly yet competitive environment.
course_highlights: Several categories, including youth and adults
Start in front of the Strážske Municipal Office building
A traditional race with a long history and community support
additional: The event has a long-standing tradition, and in 2026 it will be held for the 49th time. Runners are divided into several age groups, including preschoolers, schoolchildren, and adults. After the race, the fastest runners in each category receive awards, and a raffle with valuable prizes is held. The course runs through the city of Strážske, with the finish in front of the Municipal Office building.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
location: Náchod-Běloves, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Dobrošov je veřejný závod v běhu do vrchu s hromadným startem, který se koná v Náchodě-Bělovesu v Královéhradeckém kraji. Tento závod je součástí série Běžecké vršky a nabízí sportovcům možnost změřit síly na náročné trati vedoucí do vrchu. Závod je organizován klubem Redpoint Teplice nad Metují a je oblíbený mezi běžci, kteří mají rádi výzvy v přírodním prostředí. Tradičně se zde setkávají běžci všech věkových kategorií a úrovní výkonnosti.
course_highlights: Běh do vrchu s hromadným startem
Náročná trať v přírodním prostředí Náchoda-Bělovesu
Součást série Běžecké vršky
additional: Jedná se o veřejný horský běh s různými kategoriemi, včetně historických informací o závodě a souvisejících akcích.

name: Karneval-Marathon
description: The Carnival Marathon in Köln-Pesch combines a passion for marathon running with enthusiasm for the Cologne Carnival. The event takes place on 11.11.2026 and is a unique event marking the start of the “fifth season.” The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and follows a flat, paved loop around Pescher See, which runners complete multiple times. The field is limited to 50 participants, and costumes are expressly encouraged to add to the fun.
course_highlights: 15 laps of 2.732 km plus a 1.215 km out-and-back section at the start for the marathon distance
Flat loop around Pescher See in a protected landscape area
Refreshment station in the start/finish area, passed every 2.7 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:30 to 10:30 at the playground at Pescher See. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the nearby clubhouse of FC Pesch 1956 e.V. Timing is manual, with lap numbers clipped off the race bib. After the race, there will be Kölsch and a unique Carnival finisher’s medal. The event is non-commercial, and proceeds will be donated to Cologne Carnival associations. The course is a paved 2.7 km loop; there is no lighting or medical station. The number of race numbers is limited to 50. No refunds are given for non-participation or force majeure. Participation is open to runners aged U20 and older.

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Running Club “Rzeszów Biega,” in partnership with the Rzeszów City Hall and PKO Bank Polski. The 10 km main race starts and finishes at Rzeszów Market Square and takes place on November 11 at 11:11. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpackie region, offering age-group classifications and special categories, including for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, bib number and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish. The participant limit is 3,000, and entrants must confirm they are fit to run by providing a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race starts and finishes at Rzeszów Market Square
Separate age-group classifications and special categories, including for doctors and lawyers
Participant limit of 3,000; race pack includes a T-shirt, bib number and chip
additional: Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of 30 zł. The number of race packs available on race day is limited, and the entry fee is non-refundable. Participants must be over 16 (minors require parental or guardian consent). Participants receive race packs containing a T-shirt, bib number and chip. The course is marked every 1 km, and the event includes warm-ups and refreshment stations along the course. Wearing the organizer’s T-shirt is mandatory.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
description: The 35th Independence Run in Warsaw is an annual running event held to celebrate National Independence Day. The main 10 km race takes place on the streets of the capital, with the start and finish on Jana Pawła II Avenue. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, and also offers a Nordic walking category and the accompanying Independence Mile, covering 1,918 m. The main race starts in waves to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. The organizers provide a varied program and efficient race services, including convenient pre-race bib collection dates.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Warsaw certified by the PZLA
Start and finish on Jana Pawła II Avenue, level with Miła Street
Wave starts for the main race, with runners divided into zones according to their expected finish time
additional: The main race starts at 11:11, with wave starts divided into time zones. The Independence Mile starts at 10:00. Athletes using active wheelchairs, handbikes, and tandems start at 11:08. Race bibs can be collected at Westfield Arkadia from November 7–10. On race day, the race office is closed, except for package collection by participants from outside Warsaw between 8:00 and 10:00. Participants are asked to line up at the start wearing white or red shirts to form a red-and-white flag. The route is well-known and popular, and around 20,000 people take part in the event. The event includes various running categories, including the main race, Nordic walking, and virtual options available until November 17. In previous years, the event was the largest running event in Poland.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

name: 10 Bieg Niepodległości z wąsem
location: Stadion Olimpijski, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Wrocław Independence Day Run with a Mustache is an annual running event held at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, commemorating the 107th anniversary of Poland regaining independence. Participants can choose between the 10 km and 5 km distances, and the main race course is certified by the PZLA. The race takes place on roads closed to traffic, and runners receive a medal and a post-race meal at the finish. Free accompanying runs are available for younger participants, and runners can purchase a high-quality technical T-shirt featuring the race logo.
course_highlights: The PZLA-certified 10 km course consists of two 5 km loops
Start and finish at the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium
The course follows asphalt and gravel roads at the foot of the flood embankments
additional: Race packs can be collected from the race office at the Olympic Stadium on November 10 and 11. The pack contains a race number, mustache-patterned socks, a stick-on mustache, sponsor products, a calendar, a T-shirt (if ordered), a medal, and a post-race meal. There is a hydration station on the course. The race takes place on roads closed to traffic. Free accompanying runs are organized for children. Technical T-shirts can be ordered until 16.10.2025 for 90 zł. Changing rooms and a bag deposit are available on site. The 5 km race starts at 10:11 and the 10 km race at 11:11. The race takes place on roads closed to traffic; accompanying runs for children are available; T-shirts can be purchased through the registration form on datasport; participants receive medals; on-the-day registration is available.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
location: Centrum Rekreacyjno-Sportowe Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with celebrations of Independence Day. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to families with children. The races take place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and include 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 metres. The atmosphere is lively despite the autumn weather, and places are limited, with online registration open until 6 November.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km routes run through the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre grounds and along nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana and Kapitańska
The event combines sporting competition with patriotic celebrations
Nordic walking and children’s races of up to 400 metres are also available
additional: The start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre. The event takes place on 11 November, and registration is open online until 6 November. Participants can choose from the 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 m. Traffic disruptions should be expected along the race route. Traffic disruptions along the route; start at 9:00; registration until 6 November; event at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and on Sielska, Schumana and Kapitańska streets.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix. The 10 km main race attracts runners of all ages, and there are also races for children and young people. The event combines sport and recreation, with participants able to expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Poland’s independence. Photos and video footage are taken during the event for the organizers’ promotional purposes.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Races for children and young people
Part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix
additional: Photos and video footage will be taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of the City of Gdynia. Registration until October 28, 2026; results, photo galleries, and information about event partners are available.

name: XIV Bieg Niepodległości
description: The 14th Independence Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Rzeszów, promoting an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region. The start and finish are at Rzeszów Market Square, and the race takes place on November 11, Poland’s Independence Day. Runners compete in multiple age categories and special classifications, including those for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race pack containing a T-shirt, race number and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish. The participant limit is 3,000, and entrants must confirm they are fit to run by providing a medical certificate or a declaration.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race starting and finishing at Market Square in Rzeszów
Separate age-group and special classifications (e.g. doctors and the legal profession)
A commemorative medal for every participant at the finish
additional: The participant limit is 3,000. Participants must be at least 16 years old on race day. Minors may participate with the consent of a parent or legal guardian. The race pack contains a T-shirt, race number and chip. Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of 30 zł. The entry fee is non-refundable. On race day, race packs are available only for cash and in limited quantities. Participants can expect a clearly marked course, detailed safety regulations, and information about registration and participant limits. The race takes place in Rytro, and the event is part of the National Independence Day celebrations.

name: 1. Prusicki Bieg Niepodległości
location: Prusice, Trzebnica County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Chełmski Nocny Półmaraton z Duchem Bielu...
Krakowski Bieg Niepodległości im. dr Wiesława Maczka
XIV Radomski Bieg i Marsz Niepodległości
XV Bieg Niepodległości Niepodległościowa Jedenastka
location: Biały Kościół, Gmina Wielka Wieś, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec je tradiční podzimní trailový závod v okolí Plzně, který nabízí malebné tratě v přírodě s minimem asfaltu. Závod je určen jak pro příznivce zdravého pohybu v přírodě, tak pro výkonnostní atlety a vrcholové trailisty. Na výběr jsou tratě o délce 42 km s převýšením 700 m, 22,5 km, 7 km a kratší dětské a žákovské tratě včetně multigenerační štafety. Centrum závodu je v příměstské části Plzeň - Bílá hora, kde se koná i start a cíl. Pořadatelé se drží hesla „Po asfaltu neběhám“ a připravují závod s důrazem na běh v přírodě a krásné výhledy.
course_highlights: Malebné tratě po pěšinkách po obou březích údolí řeky Berounky
Lesy okolo Boleveckých rybníků
Výběh na Krkavec s převýšením 700 m na maratonské trati
additional: K dispozici jsou tři hlavní tratě (42 km, 22,5 km, 7 km) a kratší dětské a žákovské tratě včetně multigenerační štafety. Závod je součástí Běžeckého poháru Plzeňska. Centrum závodu je v příměstské části Plzeň - Bílá hora. Terén: trail, cross-country; závod se koná v listopadu 2026, přesné registrační detaily nejsou uvedeny

name: BoBoBěh
description: BoBoběh je závěrečný horský běh trilogie BoBoloppet, který vede krásami Jizerských hor. Závod nabízí náročnou trasu dlouhou 30 km s výstupy na Olivetskou horu, průběhem přes hráz Černé Nisy a těžkým stoupáním Bílým Štolpichem. Pro méně zkušené běžce je k dispozici kratší trasa 10 km a dětský MINI běh na 1 km. Závod je otevřen všem milovníkům běhu a přírody, ať už jsou registrováni na celou trilogii, nebo chtějí absolvovat jen tento závod.
course_highlights: 30 km horský běh přes Vysoký hřeben a Kanál
Dvakrát výběh na Olivetskou horu a průběh přes hráz Černé Nisy
Nejtěžší stoupání v Jizerkách - Bílý Štolpich
additional: Závod nemá hromadný start, startovní koridor je otevřen dvě hodiny, kdy si závodníci volí čas startu. Trasa není značená, závod je částečně orientačním během. K dispozici jsou tři varianty: 30 km, 10 km (fit) a dětský MINI běh 1 km. Akce je otevřená všem zájemcům, nabízí možnost registrace na různé trasy, a klade důraz na přírodní krásy a sportovní zážitky v horském prostředí.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
description: Běh přes Černovírský les je rovinatý závod na 10 km, který se koná v Hlušovicích u Olomouce. Závod je součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje a přitahuje regionální běžce, kteří si užívají trať vedoucí po cyklostezkách a asfaltu. Akce je určena pro běžce všech věkových kategorií a nabízí nejen sportovní zážitek, ale i možnost setkání s místní běžeckou komunitou. Závod je vítanou příležitostí, jak si užít podzimní atmosféru a aktivně strávit čas v přírodě.
course_highlights: Rovinatá trať vedoucí po cyklostezkách a asfaltu
Závod součástí Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
Možnost účasti v různých věkových kategoriích
additional: závod na 10 km, součást Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje, rovinatý terén, účast regionálních vytrvalců

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
description: Běh Dlouhými záhony je náročný krosový závod dlouhý 6,8 km s výraznými výškovými rozdíly, který se koná v Úpici. Závod je součástí Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a Zimní běžecké ligy O krále Jestřebích hor. Trať nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě kopcovitého terénu a krásných přírodních scenérií Jestřebích hor. Tento závod je vhodný pro zkušené běžce, kteří hledají technicky náročný horský běh.
course_highlights: Náročný kros s velkými výškovými rozdíly
Délka trati 6,8 km
Součást Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu a Zimní běžecké ligy
additional: Závod je součástí Zimní běžecké ligy a Českého poháru v běhu do vrchu, s vyhodnocením nejlepších vrchařů ČR po závodě.

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatomartinský běh je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Petřkovic u Starého Jičína v Moravskoslezském kraji. Závod nabízí sportovní zážitek v krásné přírodě s trasou dlouhou přibližně 5,5 km, která je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost. Akce je organizována v areálu Hotelu zámek Berchtold, který poskytuje zázemí a pohodlí pro účastníky i diváky. Závod je ideální pro všechny běžce, kteří chtějí spojit sport s příjemnou atmosférou a krásnými výhledy v okolí.
course_highlights: Trasa dlouhá 5,5 km v přírodním prostředí
Malebné okolí Petřkovic u Starého Jičína
Start a cíl v areálu Hotelu zámek Berchtold
additional: Výsledky z předchozích ročníků jsou dostupné online. Trasa je vedena v přírodním prostředí s převážně lesním a polním povrchem. Areál zámku Berchtold nabízí zázemí pro účastníky včetně parkování a občerstvení. Závod se koná v listopadu 2026, přesné detaily ohledně registrace a tratí nejsou uvedeny, akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a podporuje aktivní životní styl.

name: Ludgeřovický kros

price_tiers.distance: běh 10 km, 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, děti

description: Ludgeřovický kros je tradiční běžecký závod v přírodním prostředí obce Ludgeřovice, který každoročně přitahuje malé i velké běžce. Hlavní trať měří 10 km a vede členitým terénem - lesními cestami, polními pěšinami i kolem místních památek. Kromě hlavního závodu jsou k dispozici i kratší běhy na 4 km, Nordic walking na 9 km a dětské tratě podle věkových kategorií. Závod je součástí Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy a nese podtitul Běh válečných veteránů, kterým vzdává úctu hrdinům nejen z minulosti.
course_highlights: Hlavní trať 10 km s 140 m převýšením
Terén zahrnuje lesní cesty, polní pěšiny a okolí místních památek
Doplňkové závody: běh 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, dětské tratě 100 a 500 m
additional: Kovová finišerská medaile vlastního designu, pamětní magnetka pro prvních 200 na prezentaci, kniha Ještě jeden maraton pro prvních 300 přihlášených, finanční odměny pro vítěze hlavního závodu, čipová časomíra i pro dětské běžce, vyhlašování i 4. místa ve všech závodech, doprovodný program Den válečných veteránů Ludgeřovice, osobní video a fotografie ze závodu, šatny, sprchy a pohodlné parkování, dětské běhy s vyhlášením a tombola. Trať na 10 km, 9 km, 4 km, dětské běhy, počasí nejisté, propojení s Dnem válečných veteránů

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
description: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka je silniční obrátkový závod vedoucí z Moravských Budějovic do Lukova a zpět. Tento závod nabízí běžcům příležitost změřit síly na půlmaratonské trati v malebném prostředí Vysočiny. Závod je vhodný pro všechny běžce, kteří hledají kvalitní silniční běh s tradiční atmosférou. Organizátoři vítají zkušené i začínající běžce a těší se na vaši účast.
course_highlights: Silniční obrátkový závod z Moravských Budějovic do Lukova a zpět
Malebné prostředí Vysočiny
Tradiční půlmaratonská trať
additional: Závod je určen pro všechny věkové kategorie a je součástí běžecké ligy, nabízí příjemnou atmosféru a možnost zúčastnit se i jako rekreační běžec.

name: Hubertův lesní trail
location: Lesní „Finská“ běžecká stezka near Lesní hřbitov, Malšovice, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50,- kč dětské kategorie (předem na účet i v den registrace na místě)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 250,- kč dospělý při registraci přes internet do 10.11.2026

description: Hubertův lesní trail je běžecký závod pro děti i dospělé, který se koná v krásném prostředí hradeckých lesů na Lesní "Finské" běžecké stezce v Malšovicích. Start i cíl jsou situovány nedaleko Lesního hřbitova. Závod nabízí dětské kategorie s kratšími tratěmi bez měření času a hlavní závod pro dospělé. Pro první tři závodníky v každé kategorii jsou připraveny medaile a drobné dárky. Výsledky jsou zveřejněny do 24 hodin po závodě na webu pořadatele.
course_highlights: Lesní "Finská" běžecká stezka v Malšovicích
Start a cíl 200 m od Lesního hřbitova
Krásné lesní prostředí hradeckých lesů
additional: Registrace je možná online do 10.11.2026 nebo na místě v den závodu. Dětské kategorie startují od 10:20, prezence dětí je od 09:30 do 10:15. Hlavní závod dospělých startuje mezi 11:00-11:45. Pro první tři závodníky v každé kategorii jsou připraveny medaile a drobné dárky. Výsledky jsou zveřejněny do 24 hodin na webu pořadatele. Dětské závody startují v 10:20 a hlavní závod ve 12:00. Startovné zahrnuje měření času, občerstvení a medaili; první tři v každé kategorii získají také drobný dárek. MHD: linka 9, zastávka Lesní hřbitov; parkování je u Lesního hřbitova.

name: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov
location: Louka, Malá Víska, Zaječov, Czech Republic
description: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov je běžecký závod konaný ve dvou dnech v lokalitě Louka, Malá Víska u Zaječova. Závod nabízí dvě etapy - dlouhou 13,5 km s převýšením 330 m a krátkou 6,7 km s převýšením 190 m, které se konají na tratích původně určených pro závody psích spřežení. Hlavní výzvou je soutěž v kombinaci obou etap o celkovou délku 20,2 km s převýšením 520 m. Závod je otevřený všem bez rozdílu pohlaví a věku, přičemž výsledný čas je upraven koeficientem podle věku a pohlaví. Start dlouhé etapy je v sobotu v 9:00, krátké etapy v neděli v 8:30.
course_highlights: Dlouhá etapa 13,5 km s převýšením 330 m
Krátká etapa 6,7 km s převýšením 190 m
Trasy vedou loukami a lesními cestami připravenými pro závody psích spřežení
additional: Registrace probíhá pouze online a je nutné se registrovat zvlášť na každou etapu. Startovní čísla se vyzvedávají v sobotu od 7:00 a v neděli. Soutěž je bez rozdílu pohlaví a věku, výsledné časy jsou upraveny koeficientem podle věku a pohlaví. Po každé etapě se vyhlašuje prvních 5 závodníků, při účasti v obou etapách se sčítají časy a vyhlašuje se prvních 10 s nejrychlejším součtem. Registrace probíhá pouze online do 11. 11. 2026. Pro účast v kombinaci je nutné přihlásit se na každou etapu zvlášť; startovné musí být uhrazeno do 11. 11. 2026.

name: Kuchařovická výzva
location: Víceúčelové zařízení (kulturní dům), Kuchařovice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč hlavní závod; 50 Kč dětské závody

price_tiers.distance: Muži 8,4 km / Ženy 5,9 km / Děti 150 m

description: Kuchařovická výzva je běžecký závod pořádaný v Kuchařovicích, který nabízí tratě pro muže, ženy i děti. Mužská trať měří 8,4 km s převýšením 114 m, ženská 5,9 km s převýšením 71 m, a dětská trať je dlouhá 150 m. Závod se koná v příjemném prostředí s převážně lesními cestami a asfaltovými úseky, což zajišťuje zvlněný profil trati. Start i prezence probíhají před víceúčelovým zařízením v Kuchařovicích, což vytváří přátelskou atmosféru pro všechny účastníky.
course_highlights: Zvlněný profil trati s převýšením 114 m (muži) a 71 m (ženy)
70 % lesní cesty a 30 % asfalt
Start a cíl před víceúčelovým zařízením v Kuchařovicích
additional: Prezence a registrace hlavního závodu probíhá od 8:30 do 9:30 před víceúčelovým zařízením v Kuchařovicích. Parkování je možné u restaurace Emrammus, u mateřské školy a na ulici Větrná. Start a zázemí jsou u víceúčelového zařízení (kulturního domu) v Kuchařovicích. Uváděné dětské tratě měří 100, 300 a 600 m. Parkování je možné u restaurace Emrammus, u mateřské školy nebo v ulici Větrná.

name: Hrouzovka 2026
description: Hrouzovka 2026 je běžecký závod, který se uskuteční 14. listopadu 2026 v Krnově. Tento závod nabízí trať dlouhou přibližně 15 km, vedoucí přes kopcovitý terén s různorodým povrchem, včetně asfaltu, trávy a kamenitých cest. Akce je určena pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu v přírodním prostředí a chtějí si užít sportovní atmosféru v krásném okolí. Podrobnosti o organizátorovi a registraci zatím nejsou zveřejněny, ale závod je součástí místního běžeckého kalendáře.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It comprises several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The races each start at 2:00 p.m. at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. The series promotes a sense of community with a series classification for participants who take part in all three races. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the fastest runners follow the finish.
course_highlights: Course profiles for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km are available on Komoot
Start and finish at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with a passive transponder from Raceresult
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series classification for participants who take part in all three races in the series. After finishing, runners receive a complimentary soft drink. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at the Harbig Hall. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, recognising the three fastest participants (men/women) in each race on the day, as well as the age-group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, several race distances, community event in November 2026

name: Alzauenlauf TSV Trostberg

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 10 km: Männer und Frauen, Senioren und Seniorinnen: 22 €

description: The Alzauenlauf in Trostberg is a long-running event taking place on 14 November 2026. The 10 km main course runs through the picturesque Trostberg Alzauen, an idyllic wooded area along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee. The course combines pleasant natural forest trails with a lap in the stadium, offering a varied running experience. Shorter distances are also available for children and young people. Refreshments are provided for all participants in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Alois-Böck sports hall.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the picturesque Trostberg Alzauen on natural terrain
Start and finish in the stadium, with one and a half laps before the forest section
The course runs along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee
additional: Bib collection from 10:30 to 13:00 at the Alois-Böck sports hall. Electronic chip timing, with the chip integrated into the bib. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Alois-Böck sports hall. Participants who register for the 10 km course at least 14 days before the race will receive a technical shirt; after that, shirts are available while stocks last. Late registration is possible for an additional fee of €5. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Refreshments are provided for everyone at the finish. Participants must accept the DLV terms and conditions. The event includes refreshments, changing rooms, showers and chip timing; online registration is available. Family-friendly and suitable for all age groups.

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The District Cross-Country Championships in Velpke are a long-standing cross-country running competition organized by the NLV Braunschweig District. The event gives runners of various age groups, from children to Masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course crosses varied terrain and offers a challenging test for all participants. Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, adults, and Masters
Organized by the NLV Braunschweig District in Velpke
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer is the NLV Braunschweig District. The event category is 6.4.2 District Championships. Cross-country terrain; registration deadline is February 1, 2026; various course distances, including children’s and youth categories.

name: Biegerparklauf
location: Biegerpark, Duisburg-Huckingen, Duisburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Biegerparklauf in Duisburg-Huckingen is an officially DLV-measured race on asphalt, with distances of 1.2 km for schoolchildren, 5 km for everyone, and 10 km for youth and adults. The races follow a loop through Biegerpark, with the final 300 meters run on the stadium’s cinder track. All participants receive certificates; schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner, and the top runners are awarded medals. The event is organized by Sportgemeinschaft Duisburg-Süd 98/20 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Loop through Biegerpark on asphalt
10 km runners complete 3 laps; 5 km runners complete 2 laps
The final 300 meters are on the stadium’s cinder track
additional: Late entries are possible in limited numbers on the event day, up to 30 minutes before the start. Certificates are issued online and at the venue, where there may be a wait. Schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner at the finish. The event provides sports liability insurance under the NRW sports aid insurance agreement. The final 300 meters are run on the stadium’s cinder track. Course: loop through Biegerpark, paved paths, final 300 m on the cinder track; dates and registration by email; start times for different age groups; medals and Weckmänner for children.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championships and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a wider German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.
course_highlights: Red course: 2 km run
Blue course: 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km laps)
Start and finish at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Crosslauf Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a long-standing cross-country race in Gudensberg, offering short off-road distances. The start and finish are on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course runs mostly on unpaved paths, and spikes are allowed, emphasizing its classic cross-country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach with TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mostly on unpaved paths; spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (one longer lap)
additional: Depending on the event announcement, district championships may be included. Typical November weather is expected, with temperatures around 7 °C and rainy days. November is usually rainy; the terrain has a cross-country style. The event honors Hermann Kilian for his dedication to running.

name: Herzowerke-Trail 2026
location: TSH sports grounds, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 3rd Herzowerke Trail takes place on 14 November 2026 in Herzogenaurach. The trail starts and finishes at the TSH sports grounds and runs through the Dohnwald around the town. There are several distances from 0.5 km to 16 km; the longest distance can be run as one or two laps. This is a true forest trail, and poles are permitted. There are no refreshment stations along the course; refreshments are available only in the start and finish area. The event is organised by the running section of Turnerschaft Herzogenaurach.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dohnwald around Herzogenaurach
A true trail where poles are permitted
Refreshments only in the start and finish area; no support along the course
additional: There are several distances: 0.5 km Bambini Trail, 2 km Kids Trail, 4 km Youth Trail, 8 km Speed Trail and 16 km (one or two laps). Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; there are no drink or refreshment stations in the forest. Times, results and placings will be published online. The top three will be honoured. A trail with various distances, self-sufficiency required on forest sections, start and finish at the TSH sports grounds, results and placings online. Cold and wet November weather is possible.

name: Int. DEULUX-Lauf
description: The International DEULUX Run takes place annually on the second Saturday in November in Langsur and offers four different races for all age groups. From a 360-meter run for the youngest participants to the 10-kilometer road race—the largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate—there is something for everyone. The event is part of the 4-Regio Cup and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can look forward to varied courses and special awards.
course_highlights: Four different races, from 360 m to 10 km
The largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate
Family-friendly event with a special award for every participant
additional: Start times: youngest participants’ race 13:30, children’s race 14:00, youth race 14:30, main race 15:00. All children’s races are free to enter. RFID chip timing for the children’s and youth races. Late entries are not possible, including on the day of the event. Several race distances, including children’s and youth races; registration will open in a few weeks. The event takes place in Langsur.

name: Kerner Nachtlauf
description: The Kerner Night Run is an atmospheric autumn race taking place on the evening of Saturday, November 14, 2026, in Kernen. Runners set off at dusk on a loop of approximately 4.5 km along illuminated paths through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets around Kernen. A 10 km distance is also offered. The event celebrates a passion for running and the shared enjoyment of sport in a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4.5 km loop along illuminated paths
The course passes through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets
Starts at dusk on Saturday evening
additional: Run along illuminated paths, with 4.5 km and 10 km options; an atmosphere enhanced by lights and torches; finish in the stadium with snacks and drinks

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The KLV Segeberg open cross-country race takes place every November in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults and Masters, with distances ranging from approximately 625 m to 7.9 km. The event is open to runners from across Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs across meadows, parks and wooded areas, offering a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organised by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, which also hosts it on site.
course_highlights: Distances of approximately 625 m to 7.9 km
The course runs through Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park, across meadows, parks and wooded areas
Open event with categories for children, youth, adults and Masters
additional: Typical November weather, around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg cross-country championship series, which also includes other local club venues in the Segeberg district. Cross-country running in November in typical rainy weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C, on an outdoor course, suitable for trail running and cross-country fans.

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition takes place on 14 November 2026 and offers runners of different ability levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and support from numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is especially popular and has attracted many more participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with a construction detour; the 5 km loop is eligible for rankings
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and drinking water at Durstlöscher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers, who help ensure the event runs smoothly along the course, in the start and finish areas, and at refreshment stations. Sponsors include the RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction detour on the 15 km course, but the 5 km loop remains eligible for rankings. An extensive photo album is available online. Courses on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed; online registration opens on 01.09.2025; start times from 11:30 a.m.; medals for children; prizes in kind for winners; limited parking; showers available.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, held as part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), takes place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. It offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and take part in a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Off-stadium course in Potsdam
Event held as part of a national championship
additional: The entry deadline is November 9, 2026; the scenic venue offers a varied cross-country course.

name: Potzberg-Berglauf
description: The Potzberg Mountain Run is a traditional hill race organised by TuS Glan-Münchweiler. The course covers 8.2 kilometres with 350 metres of elevation gain and offers runners a challenging experience in the beautiful landscape around Potzberg. The race takes place annually and attracts both ambitious runners and hill-running enthusiasts. The organisers thank their sponsors and are happy to answer any further questions.
course_highlights: Course distance: 8.2 kilometres
Elevation gain: 350 metres
Landscape around Potzberg
additional: The Potzberg Mountain Run is the 4th race in 2026. Results from previous races are available on the website. No events or registration dates are listed on the website. TuS Glan-Münchweiler can be contacted by telephone for further information. The race is part of the Pfälzer Berglauf-Pokal-Cup and has categories for adults and young people, as well as a convenient baggage and clothing transport service to the finish. The event takes place in November.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event held annually at Sportpark Senden, welcoming runners of all ages. The courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV, run along park paths and paths beside the canal, offering an attractive running setting. Children and young people have a separate entry option at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers changing and shower facilities, as well as refreshments including coffee, cake, soup and bratwurst. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and to a successful event.
course_highlights: Courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV
Routes run along park paths and paths beside the canal
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Refreshments including coffee, tea, cake, biscuits, soup and bratwurst provided by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Schloss Senden, along the canal and through Königspark; there is a good supply of cake, drinks and hot food; the event can take place in any weather.

name: Waldlauf
location: Remsecker Waldlauf, Hochdorfer Wald, Büchenbach, Bayern, Germany
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers a range of distances, from a Bambini run and children’s and youth races to short, middle- and long-distance races. The varied forest trails, with muddy, uneven ground and small obstacles, make the race a memorable and adventurous experience. The run is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and places great importance on community and experiencing nature.
course_highlights: All routes lead through the beautiful Hochdorf Forest
Muddy, uneven ground and narrow trails with small obstacles
A variety of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Race number collection: Friday, 16:30–18:00, and Saturday from 9:30. Each participant receives a race number with an integrated chip. Recycled technical shirts can be ordered online as an option until 05.09.2026 (children €15, adults €20). Late registration is possible on the event day until 60 minutes before the start; the late registration fee is €3.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
location: Zeil am Main, Haßberge, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Zeil Forest Marathon takes place on 14 November 2026 in Zeil am Main and offers challenging running routes through the Haßberge Nature Park. The course runs mainly along paved forest paths, following a varied route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past several lakes. Events include the marathon, half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking over 21.1 km and 7.5 km. The event is organised by TV 1884 Zeil and features professional timekeeping with an integrated chip.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park, almost entirely on paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past the Seven Lakes
Aid stations every 5 km with mineral water, tea, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the Setzbachbrunnen in the Zeil am Main running park. Timekeeping with an integrated chip. Marathon runners can switch to the half-marathon course after one lap. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car parks, as well as the Tuchanger car park, with a city bus transfer. Race number collection is at the school on Friday evening and Saturday morning. Showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. There is no baggage storage in the start/finish area. Free buses run every 5 minutes from the school building to the start line. The course runs almost entirely along paved forest paths in the Haßberge Nature Park. Aid stations are available every 5 km. Race numbers include a chip. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car park, and showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. Medals are awarded to all participants after the race, and a free bus transfer is available.

name: ILM – Ich lauf mit gegen Gewalt
W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Zemplínsky extrém – Beh v múzeu
price_range: 20€ online, 25€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ online, 5€ na mieste pre deti
description: Zemplínsky extrém – Run in the Museum is an autumn running race held on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce on 14 November 2026. The race offers a unique experience in the museum’s cultural setting and the surrounding countryside. It is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events in the region. Runners can look forward to an interesting course with an autumn atmosphere and a sense of local history.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
An autumn setting with a cultural touch
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events
additional: The event takes place on 14 November 2026. It includes several categories, including children’s races, and is held on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce.

name: Beh na Minčol
description: The Minčol Run is a challenging uphill mountain race in the beautiful surroundings of the Višňovská Valley. The route follows a marked hiking trail with steep climbs all the way to the summit of Minčol at an elevation of 1,363 m, where runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra. The race is for bold runners who want to test their abilities on a demanding course with little room to rest. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.
course_highlights: Marked hiking trail with blue blazes
Steep climbs from the start to the finish
Finish at the summit of Minčol, with views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra
additional: Race check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. Results will be announced shortly after the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:30. There are refreshments on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish; after the race, lunch is served (homemade kapustnica and a drink). Runners can use a drop bag, which will be transported to the facilities below the ski slope, where the prizes will be presented. The organizers arrange transport of runners’ belongings to the results ceremony venue. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.

name: Ferčekovská desiatka
location: Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Malé pole
description: Ferčekovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Ferčekovce, near Spišská Nová Ves, with courses for children, juniors, and adults. The race takes place on forest roads and rolling, grassy terrain, creating a pleasant natural setting for runners of all ages. It is organized by Športový klub Ferčekovce in cooperation with the city of Spišská Nová Ves. The race is suitable for the general public, including families and running enthusiasts, who can choose from several categories and distances.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Geislinger Volkslauf
description: The Geislingen Volkslauf is a long-established running event held annually in Geislingen. It offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages, including student races and an integration run. The course starts at the Schlossparkhalle and is known for its varied, well-organized route. The event is popular in the region and is hosted by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V.
course_highlights: Start at the Schlossparkhalle Geislingen
Student race for all school grades
Inclusion run for inclusive participation
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, 15 November 2026. There are student races and an integration run. The event is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V. The start is at 10:30 a.m. at the Schlossparkhalle. Runners can register online until 12 November 2025; the event includes children’s, youth, open and masters competitions.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Probelauf
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf in Tübingen is a traditional half marathon organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for ranking lists. The route runs along finely graveled forest paths and paved sections with moderate climbs, and water, tea, and special sports drinks are available at several refreshment stations. A high-quality technical shirt is included in the entry fee for all participants and can be collected at the runners’ expo. In addition to the main race, there is also a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for ranking lists
Finely graveled forest paths and approx. 8.5 km of paved paths
Maximum elevation difference approx. 82 meters; total elevation gain approx. 300 meters
additional: Refreshments at kilometers 5, 11, and 17 with water, tea, and UltraSports products; finish refreshments with raisin rolls, water, UltraRefresher, and hot tea; start and finish at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, near the runners’ expo; runners’ expo and race office in the sports hall of Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; free Nikolauslauf app for current information and race bib management; high-quality technical shirt included in the entry fee, with the option to exchange it at the runners’ expo; shirts for virtual 10 km participants are shipped within Germany only. The test run takes place on November 16, 2025, is free, and requires no registration; run in groups with pacers; parking available at Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; finish refreshments with pretzels and vegetable broth; no shower facilities on site.

name: Jetzendorfer Hobby Crosslauf
description: The Jetzendorf Hobby Cross-Country Run is a local cross-country event held at LOWA Stadium in Jetzendorf, Bavaria. Organized by TSV Jetzendorf, the event takes place in November and offers various distances for different age groups. It is aimed at recreational runners, families, and club athletes, and is now in its 17th edition. In addition to the running races, there is also a Nordic walking course suitable for beginners and recreational walkers.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at LOWA Stadium Jetzendorf
Distances from 650 m to 5.8 km
Nordic walking course, approx. 2.9 km
additional: The program includes an 800 m stadium cross-country race for younger children, approx. 1,600 m for older children and teenagers, and the main race of approx. 5.8 km for older teenagers and adults. The event takes place in the morning in November. Typical November weather, with temperatures of approx. 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. Several running distances and a Nordic walking option make the event ideal for families and recreational runners. The event takes place in November at LOWA Stadium.

name: Kreis Herbst Waldlauf Meisterschaften
description: The District Autumn Forest Running Championships take place on 15 November 2026 in Usingen/Merzhausen. This event is part of the traditional competitions organised by the HLV Hochtaunus District and gives runners in various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course winds through autumnal woodland and promises a varied, nature-filled running environment. The championships are an important fixture in the regional athletics calendar and support the development of young athletes.
course_highlights: Run through autumnal woodland
Nature-filled cross-country course
Event in Usingen/Merzhausen
additional: Weather-dependent event in November; no fixed distances for all categories; regional event with several participating clubs

name: Offenbacher Behörden- und Volkswaldlauf
price_range: Erwachsene 6,00 EUR, Jugendliche U18/U20 3,00 EUR, U10-U16 1,00 EUR, Nachmeldung 2,00 EUR
description: The Offenbach Authorities and Volkswald Run is a traditional running event that has taken place annually since 1972. The race is open to municipal employees, company sports participants and guest runners, who compete on forest paths in Offenbach am Main. The course is 100% forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. In addition to individual events, there are team classifications, with trophies for the winners. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers shower and changing facilities as well as free refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Course consists entirely of forest paths
Start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings
Various distances for youth, adults and walkers
additional: The Authorities Forest Run takes place in all weather conditions. Shower and changing facilities are available at the Arbeiterwohlfahrt recreation grounds. Free tea is offered after the finish. The award ceremonies include trophies for team winners and individual events. For travel, participants are advised to use the car park at Nasses Dreieck, opposite the Stadthalle. The course consists entirely of forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. Registration is open until November 6, 2025; late entries are accepted until 9:30 a.m. on race day. Free tea, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg
location: Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, Freiburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 50th Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg is a traditional cross-country race in Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, organized by TV Riegel. The event offers various distances for children, young people, open runners and Masters, including short cross-country and road races. The courses run around Michaelsberg and offer local runners and young athletes an excellent opportunity to gain race experience. The longest distance is 8.1 km and is open to men, women and Masters.
course_highlights: Cross-country race around Michaelsberg
Distances from 0.5 km to 8.1 km
Separate starts for children, young people, open runners and Masters
additional: The program includes children's races (520 m), youth races (840 m, 1,400 m), a 2,900 m race for older youths and adults, and the main race over 8,100 m. Typical November weather, with temperatures around 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. An off-road running event in November, with typical weather conditions around 7°C, often rainy, and various distances for all age groups.

name: Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition
description: The Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition takes place in Xanten, with the 5 km race as the main distance. The race is held on an afternoon in November and promises a cross-country feel on the beach, setting it apart from a regular road race. Alongside the main distance, there are shorter 400 m races and longer 7.5 km races, offering suitable distances for both young and experienced runners. Children’s and youth races are also part of the program. The finish line for all races is at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten.
course_highlights: Cross-country feel on the beach
Distances from 400 m to 7.5 km
Finish line at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten
additional: Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C, and rainy weather on most days. Results are linked via RUNME.de. Children’s and youth races, a weather-dependent November event, outdoor atmosphere at Naturbad Xantener Südsee

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

name: XXIV Maraton Odrzański
description: The 24th Odra Marathon is a race held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle and organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation. The event offers two categories: a full marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. It is a sporting and recreational event, with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle as its partner. The race office operates on the days before the race and on race day, providing support for participants.
course_highlights: Marathon and half-marathon courses in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation
In partnership with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre
additional: The race office is open on 14.11.2025 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 15.11.2025 from 7:00 to 8:30. Organizers' telephone contacts: Piotr (+48) 500 028 811, Piotr (+48) 604 589 483, Ania (+48) 602 534 780. The event's partner is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. Electronic timekeeping; a 6-hour time limit; the event includes both a marathon and a half marathon and takes place in November in Kędzierzyn-Koźle.

name: Bolszewo dla Niepodległej
location: Bolszewo, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Komprachcicka Niepodległościowa Dycha
location: Komprachcice, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: Beh jastrabskými vŕškami – 3. ročnik memoriálu Jána Dobáka
location: Šarišské Jastrabie, Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, ZŠ s MŠ Šarišské Jastrabie
price_range: € (rôzne kategórie, niektoré zadarmo pre špecifické skupiny)
description: The Run through the Jastrabie Hills is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults across various age groups and disciplines, including 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The children’s race starts at 12:30 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The organizers, the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Šarišské Jastrabie Primary School and Kindergarten, welcome runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jastrabie Hills in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie
Categories for various age groups and disciplines, including Nordic walking
Start at the Šarišské Jastrabie Municipal Office grounds
additional: On-site registration is possible only in exceptional cases, by arrangement with the organizer. Children’s categories, residents of Šarišské Jastrabie, men over 70, and women over 60 can enter for free. A discounted race bundle is available for Z Ľubotína na Hrad Plaveč + Run through the Jastrabie Hills. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses; registration is available online and on-site, and prices vary by category and registration method. Categories are also offered for children, seniors, and Nordic walking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. It is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a race series with points awarded by men’s and women’s categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the race starting at 10:00. The categories are children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Runners can also earn points for improving their times during the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. Competitors vie for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points calculated using coefficients based on year of birth. In the event of a tie, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the fewest points are removed (amnesty). Registration is available on site; the event is held in several rounds throughout the year, with each race covering approximately 2 miles (3.218 km).

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Beh na Husárik is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucký Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. Held in honor of Students’ Day, the race gives runners the chance to test themselves in beautiful mountain surroundings. The start is always at 11:00, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the Mayor of Čadca’s Cup awarded to the winners. The Beh na Husárik is suitable for the general public interested in sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain surroundings around the Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race held in honor of Students’ Day
Mayor of Čadca’s Cup for the winners
additional: Online registration is closed. You can also register on race day for the increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on 15 November 2026, with a start at 11:00. Online registration is available; the course is hilly and trail-based. The race is held in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

name: Hermanovská desiatka
location: Hermanovce nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Hermanovce nad Topľou a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 10,- € Povinná do 10.11.2025 cez QR kód

description: Hermanovská desiatka is a running race organized by the Municipality of Hermanovce nad Topľou and the Hermanovce Running Club. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Hermanovce nad Topľou and offers categories for children, youth, and adults. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Competition for different age groups, including children, youth, and adults
Organized in the picturesque surroundings of Hermanovce nad Topľou
Registration available via QR code; low entry fee of €10
additional: The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including local categories. Registration is required by 10.11.2025 via QR code. The race is open to runners of all levels, with categories for children, youth, and adults. The event takes place on 15 November 2026, with the children’s race starting at 12:00 and the adults’ race at 14:00.

name: Krosová 12°
description: Krosová 12° je závod v běhu na 12 km nebo 6 km, který vede po kopcovitém 6 km okruhu v okolí Velešína v Jihočeském kraji. Tento krosový závod nabízí běžcům výzvu v podobě náročného terénu s převýšením, ideální pro milovníky přírodních běhů a kopcovitých tratí. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost, která si chce vyzkoušet běh v terénu s krásnými výhledy a přírodní atmosférou. Po závodě je možné využít doporučené vybavení a doplňky pro běh, které jsou prezentovány na oficiálním webu.
course_highlights: Kopcovitý 6 km okruh s převýšením
Možnost volby mezi tratí 12 km a 6 km
Přírodní terén s výhledy v okolí Velešína
additional: Závod nabízí dvě varianty délky trati: 12 km a 6 km, vedené po kopcovitém okruhu. Na webu jsou doporučeny běžecké vybavení a doplňky jako ponožky Ultra Trail, běžecké boty Altra a Puma, a lehké bundy vhodné do proměnlivého počasí. Závod je vhodný pro běžce všech úrovní, nabízí atraktivní kopcovitou trať a možnost volby mezi dvěma délkami závodu.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh 17. listopadu je tradiční běžecký závod v Ostravě-Hrabové, který připomíná významný den v české historii. Nabízí dvě hlavní tratě - certifikovanou 10 km Svobodnou desítku a 5 km Revoluční pětku. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a běžce všech úrovní, kteří chtějí zažít sportovní atmosféru a podpořit myšlenku svobody. Prezentace a registrace probíhají v ZŠ Paskovská, start je v dopoledních hodinách. Trasy vedou malebným prostředím Ostravy-Hrabové s dobrou dostupností MHD a možností využití sdílených kol Nextbike.
course_highlights: Certifikovaná trať 10 km Svobodná desítka
5 km Revoluční pětka
Trasy vedou Ostravou-Hrabovou s dobrou dostupností MHD
additional: Prezentace a registrace na místě probíhá v ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 od 8:30 do 9:40. Start jednotlivých závodů je dopoledne. Doprava je zajištěna MHD linkami 27, 39, 41, 77 se zastávkou Šídlovec. K dispozici jsou také sdílená kola Nextbike. Závod zahrnuje různé délky tratí, registrace jsou dostupné online, a akce má dlouhou tradici s výsledky z předchozích ročníků.

name: Sametový běh
location: Odolena Voda, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 30. 9., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 200,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 11. 11., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 300,- při registraci on-line od 12. 11. do konání závodu, platba převodem nebo v hotovosti při prezentaci

description: Sametový běh je tradiční běžecká akce pořádaná v Odoleně Vodě, která nabízí tratě pro všechny věkové kategorie včetně rodinného běhu pro rodiče s dětmi. Závod se koná na fotbalovém hřišti a zahrnuje tratě o délce 300 m, 600 m, 5 km a 10 km. Účastníci si mohou užít přátelskou atmosféru, ručně vyrobenou perníkovou medaili a po závodě malé občerstvení včetně čaje a svařáku. Organizátoři zajišťují bezpečnost trati a připravují také tombolu s pestrými cenami. Start hlavního závodu je plánován na 11:17.
course_highlights: Tratě o délce 300 m, 600 m, 5 km a 10 km
Start a cíl na fotbalovém hřišti v Odoleně Vodě
Ruční výroba perníkové medaile pro účastníky
additional: Prezentace běžců začíná od 08:45 na místě závodu. Po závodě je k dispozici malé občerstvení včetně čaje, svařáku a domácích buchet. Závodníci obdrží startovní číslo s čipem a zavírací špendlíky. Parkování je možné u Penny Marketu. Zabezpečení trati a závodu zajišťují organizátoři. Kategorie jsou rozděleny podle věku a pohlaví, včetně kategorií Bojovníci, Šampioni a Legendy. Traťové povrchy zahrnují fotbalové hřiště; akce zahrnuje tombolu, občerstvení a zábavné aktivity pro rodiny; registrace je možná na místě.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: Běh 17. listopadu v Přerově je tradiční atletickou událostí pořádanou Atletikou SK Přerov. Tento závod nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech věkových kategorií a úrovní, aby si užili sportovní atmosféru a poměřili své síly na zajímavé trati. Akce se koná v krásném prostředí města Přerov a je součástí místního atletického kalendáře. Závod je vhodný jak pro rekreační běžce, tak pro závodníky.
course_highlights: Krosový závod na 9 km s možností dětských kategorií
Součást Velké ceny vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
Dostupná registrace a výsledky online
additional: Závod je součástí místního běžeckého kalendáře, nabízí různé tratě včetně cross country a má širokou účast z regionu.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: Běh kolem koupaliště je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný Atletickým klubem Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice. Závod se koná na okruhu dlouhém 5000 metrů, který vede kolem místního koupaliště. Start je v 11:00 hodin a účastníci mohou soutěžit v několika věkových kategoriích. Zázemí závodu zahrnuje prezentaci v sportovní hale, šatny a sprchy, a po závodě probíhá vyhlášení výsledků s věcnými cenami. Závod je vhodný pro širokou veřejnost a běžce všech úrovní.
course_highlights: Okruh dlouhý 5000 metrů (4 okruhy)
Trasa vede kolem koupaliště v Kopřivnici
Start a prezentace ve sportovní hale SOU Kopřivnice
additional: Prezentace od 9:45 ve sportovní hale SOU Kopřivnice. Kategorie rozděleny podle věku a pohlaví. Šatny a sprchy zajištěny. Vyhlášení výsledků v 12:30 v bufetu sportovní haly s věcnými cenami. Registrace probíhá na sportovní hale SOU Kopřivnice, závod je určen pro muže i ženy, účastníci běží 4 okruhy, bezpečnostní značení kořenů a kamenů, občerstvení v cíli, tombola, slavnostní start výstřelem starosty

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh 17. listopadu v Kadani je tradiční běžecký závod pořádaný sportovním oddílem SK Městská policie Kadaň. Závod se koná v Rooseveltových sadech a nabízí příležitost pro běžce všech věkových kategorií. Akce je známá svou přátelskou atmosférou a podporou místní běžecké komunity. Propozice a další informace jsou k dispozici ke stažení v PDF formátu na oficiálních stránkách.
course_highlights: Závod vede Rooseveltovými sady v Kadani
Trasa vhodná pro různé věkové kategorie
Přátelská atmosféra a podpora místní běžecké komunity
additional: Propozice závodu jsou k dispozici ke stažení v PDF formátu. Výsledky a fotogalerie z předchozích ročníků jsou zveřejněny na webu. Pořadatelem je SK Městská policie Kadaň, sportovní oddíl s kontaktem na Bc. Jiřího Vlasáka. Akce zahrnuje starty na různých vzdálenostech (např. 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registrace je dostupná na webu, a akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové skupiny. Místo konání je v Rooseveltových sadech v Kadani, za sportovní halou.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh městem Hradec Králové je tradiční silniční závod, který se koná v centru města na rovinaté trati. Závod nabízí 9,7 km dlouhou trasu, která je tvořena pěti okruhy. Pro děti a žactvo je připraven kratší okruh o délce 200 metrů. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a pořádá ji TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové s podporou Českého atletického svazu.
course_highlights: 5 okruhů na rovinaté trati v centru města
Dětský okruh dlouhý 200 metrů
Silniční závod s délkou 9,7 km
additional: Start první kategorie je v 10:00, hlavní kategorie startuje v 12:00. Závod se koná v sídlišti V Lipkách u ZŠ Josefa Gočára v Hradci Králové. Pořadatelem je TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s., kontaktní osoba Jiří Brych. Závod se koná v sídlišti V Lipkách, starty jsou plánovány na 10:00 a 12:00, registrace je možná přes sportovní portál sport-reg.cz.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: Běh 17. listopadu v Poličce je tradiční terénní závod, který se koná v lesoparku Liboháj. Hlavní závod měří 6 km, rozdělený do dvou tříkilometrových okruhů, a doplňuje ho lidový běh na 3 km. Závod je součástí běžeckého poháru ISCAREX a nabízí také vložený závod ve výběhu Poličské sjezdovky pro odvážné. Startuje se na sjezdovce v 11:00, prezentace probíhá od 10:00 do 10:45. Akce je vhodná pro širokou veřejnost a běžce všech výkonnostních úrovní.
course_highlights: Krosová trať v lesoparku Liboháj s cestami a pěšinkami
Hlavní závod 6 km (2x 3 km okruh), lidový běh 3 km (1 okruh)
Vložený závod ve výběhu Poličské sjezdovky
additional: Prezentace závodníků probíhá od 10:00 do 10:45. Závod je součástí ISCAREX poháru. Vložený závod ve výběhu sjezdovky je určen pro odvážné závodníky. Počasí bývá podzimní, trať může být kluzká a zledovatělá po nočním dešti. Trať vede po cestách a pěšinách v lesoparku, soutěžní bonus ve výběhu sjezdovky, součást poháru ISCAREX 2025

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnensturm is an evening race in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-metre-long and 2.50-metre-wide track has a soft, springy surface that provides a pleasant running surface, different from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants each year and is ideal for a November race with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run on a 1,000 m-long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic track
The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the path network. It is lit from 5:00 a.m. and in the evening until 11:00 p.m. The Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park is signposted from the Hüsten exit on the A46. The event takes place on a woodchip track at the Hüsten Sports and Saline Park; in November, weather conditions can make it wet and slippery. Refreshments and showers are available on site.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: The Michalovce Liberation Run is a traditional evening race held in the city center of Michalovce.
