description: Slapy Trail Maniacs je náročný trailový závod v malebném prostředí u Slapské přehrady v Středočeském kraji. Nabízí tři tratě s délkami 61 km, 47 km a 33 km, které vedou členitým terénem s výrazným převýšením. Závod je vhodný pro zkušené běžce, kteří chtějí otestovat své schopnosti v přírodě a zároveň získat body do UTMB indexu. Centrum závodu je v obci Cholín, starty jsou rozděleny podle tratí a probíhají v sobotu. Organizátoři zajišťují i ubytování a občerstvení během závodu.
course_highlights: 61 km trať s převýšením 2300 m nahoru a 2400 m dolů
47 km trať s převýšením 1850 m nahoru i dolů
Malebné trasy v okolí Slapské přehrady s technickými úseky
additional: Start závodu 61 km je v 7:00 v Nečíně, 47 km startuje v 9:00 v Cholíně, 33 km startuje ve 12:00 u Živohošťského mostu. Limit závodu je do 23:00 v Cholíně. Ubytování je možné za 250 Kč na noc na posteli, případně na karimatce ve společenské místnosti. Změny v registraci jsou možné do 12. 10. 2025 zdarma, později za poplatek 100 Kč. Terén zahrnuje stezky, necesty, skalnaté oblasti a stoupání; závod nabízí možnosti ubytování, startovní časy a limity; součástí je i příspěvek do UTMB indexu.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Stadion AK Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomoucký kros je tradiční krosový závod pořádaný AK Olomouc, který se koná na stadionu AK Olomouc. Závod nabízí náročnou 9 km trať v terénu, která prověří vytrvalost a sílu běžců. Start hlavní kategorie je v 10:15 a závod je součástí oficiálního kalendáře Českého běhu pod Českým atletickým svazem. Pořadatelé zvou běžce všech úrovní k účasti na této oblíbené akci v Olomouci.
course_highlights: 9 km krosová trať v terénu
Start a cíl na stadionu AK Olomouc
Náročný terén vhodný pro vytrvalostní běžce
additional: Závod se koná na stadionu AK Olomouc, registrace a další podrobnosti nejsou specifikovány.

name: Skalička run
description: Skalička Run je terénní zážitkový běžecký závod konaný v malebném údolí potoka Lubě v jižní Moravě. Nabízí tři vzájemně propojené trasy o délkách 7, 13 a 22 kilometrů, které vedou převážně lesem a loukami po turistických trasách a cyklostezkách. Trasa je mírně zvlněná s několika kopci a je vhodná pro hobby běžce i pohodáře, kteří si chtějí užít krásnou přírodu a podzimní barevné scenérie. Závod je dobře značený a brody na trase jsou mělké a snadno překonatelné. V průběhu závodu je možné změnit délku běhu na kratší variantu.
course_highlights: Terénní trasa vedoucí převážně lesem a loukami mimo asfalt
Nejdelší trasa 22 km se třemi propojenými okruhy a mírným převýšením 436 m
Podzimní běh po spadaném listí s dobře značenou trasou a mělkými brody
additional: V průběhu závodu je možné změnit délku běhu na kratší variantu. Trasa je důkladně označena šipkami a fáborky. Brody jsou mělké a lze je překonat suchou nohou po lávce. Časový limit pro nejdelší trasu je 3 hodiny. Trail running, registrační údaje nejsou specifikovány, podzimní závod s krásnou přírodní atmosférou

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák je součástí seriálu Leskros, který podporuje zdravý životní styl a běhání v přírodě. Závod nabízí různé běžecké kategorie včetně půlmaratonu, desítky a kratších tratí pro děti a mládež. Součástí je také canicross s kategoriemi pro různé věkové skupiny a zkušenosti. Závod se koná v krásném lesním prostředí Hradce Králové a je vhodný pro celou rodinu i začínající běžce.
course_highlights: Lesní trasy GELOREN a MIZUNO s délkami 5 km, 10 km a půlmaraton (21 km)
Canicrossové tratě od 1 km pro děti až po 4 km pro zkušené závodníky
Občerstvovací stanice na trati a v cíli, čipová časomíra a unikátní finisherská medaile
additional: Startovné zahrnuje unikátní finisherskou medaili, speedcup kelímek, čipovou časomíru, pitný režim, občerstvení, fotografii ze závodu, dárky od partnerů a zajištění parkování. Možnost zapůjčení canicrossového vybavení po domluvě. Kategorie pro děti i dospělé, včetně juniorské a nezávodní kategorie pro začátečníky. Občerstvovací stanice na trati a v cíli, prize money pro elitní canicross závodníky. Trail running a canicross, kategorie pro děti i dospělé, registrace od prosince, akce zahrnuje charitativní aktivity a možnost zapůjčení vybavení

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
description: KEEN Prague Park Race v Prokopském údolí je běžecký závod v krásné přírodě na dohled Prahy. Závod nabízí jedinečnou atmosféru a trať vedoucí malebným údolím s přírodními i zpevněnými cestami. Prokopské údolí je ideálním místem pro milovníky běhu v přírodě, kteří chtějí zažít sportovní výzvu v klidném a malebném prostředí.
course_highlights: Trať vede po zpevněných i nezpevněných cestách v Prokopském údolí
Přírodní terén s malebnými výhledy a přírodními úseky
Závod v blízkosti města Praha s atmosférou přírodního parku
additional: Trať je přístupná v rámci závodu, není uvedeno rozdělení na vlny ani kapacitní omezení. Po registraci obdrží účastníci pokyny k platbě e-mailem. Závod je součástí série Prague Park Race s dalšími závody v Průhonickém parku, Divoké Šárce a Konopišti. Trail running, více závodů v různých parcích Prahy, registrace na webu, předzávodní běhy a akce s testováním obuvi KEEN

name: Běhej Valachy
description: Běhej Valachy je tradiční běžecký závod konaný v malebném prostředí Velkých Karlovic a okolí v Beskydech. Závod nabízí sportovcům všech věkových kategorií a kondic možnost poměřit síly v krásné přírodě s výhledem na valašské kopce. Od roku 2013 je součástí seriálu Valachy Tour, který přináší atraktivní ceny a prize money. Přijďte si užít běh v srdci Valašska a zažijte neopakovatelnou atmosféru tohoto sportovního svátku.
course_highlights: Malebné údolí Velkých Karlovic a okolí
Běh v přírodě Beskyd s valašskými kopci
Tradiční závod s dlouholetou historií od roku 2013
additional: Závod je součástí seriálu Valachy Tour, který nabízí závody v různých disciplínách pro všechny věkové kategorie a kondice. Organizátorem je MORAVIA EVENTS s.r.o. a BESKYDY OUTDOOR s.r.o. Kontaktní telefon na ředitele závodu je +420 602 275 790. Závodní trasy vedou po asfaltových a lesních cestách, s možností relaxace v termálních bazénech. Registrace začíná v 8:00, závody od 9:30. K dispozici jsou mapy tratí na mapy.cz.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
description: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava je prestižní běžecký závod, který se koná na rychlé, certifikované trati v Ostravě. Závod nabízí maraton, půlmaraton, 10 km a týmový smíšený závod, přičemž každý běžec, ať už začátečník nebo zkušený, je vítán. Atmosféra je profesionální s účastí světové elity a bohatým zázemím včetně občerstvení, hudby a sportovních nákupů. Trať vede po jednom okruhu a start i cíl jsou na slavném vítkovickém stadionu, kde Emil Zátopek dosáhl svých rekordů.
course_highlights: Rychlá, certifikovaná trať v Ostravě
Start a cíl na vítkovickém stadionu
Možnost běhu s elitními světovými běžci
additional: Startovné je možné zakoupit i na místě v hotovosti nebo QR kódem při prezentaci. Součástí startovního balíčku je originální funkční triko Macron, finišerská medaile, občerstvení během i po závodě, bohaté expo a zdarma tejpování a péče fyzioterapeuta. Běh se koná na jednom okruhu s částečnými dopravními omezeními v době závodu od 8:50 do 15:00. Závod zahrnuje různé kategorie, včetně štafetových závodů, a podporuje charitativní aktivity. Akce je spojena s podporou města Ostrava a regionu Moravskoslezský kraj.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné ULTRA 50 je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 2.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné TROJIC je stanoveno na 2.700,- Kč

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 je náročný ultramaraton dlouhý 50 km, který vede údolím řeky Moravské Sázavy ze Zábřehu přes Lázek až k pramenům řeky na Bukové hoře. Trasa nabízí krásnou přírodu s přírodním parkem Březná a přírodní rezervací Suchý vrch - Buková hora, kde závod také končí. Celkové převýšení činí 698 metrů klesání a 1369 metrů stoupání. Zázemí závodu je v Horském Resortu Buková Hora, kde si závodníci mohou po doběhu odpočinout a občerstvit se. Závod je vhodný pro běžce, kteří hledají výzvu nad rámec klasického maratonu, ale nechtějí se pouštět do extrémních 100 km horských tratí.
course_highlights: Trasa vede podél toku řeky Moravské Sázavy
Přírodní park Březná a přírodní rezervace Suchý vrch - Buková hora
Cíl na vrcholu Bukové hory s převýšením 1369 m
additional: Účastníci mohou odevzdat vlastní balíčky na občerstvovačky, které budou přepraveny. Servis je možný pouze na občerstvovačkách. Prezence je od 10:00 na startu ve Skateparku Zábřeh. Občerstvovací stanice slouží i jako místa předávky štafet. V cíli je připraven vývar s těstovinou. Výsledky jsou měřeny elektronicky i ručně, štafetový kolík je GPS lokátor s online sledováním. Na startu lze odevzdat označené balíčky k občerstvovačkám. Vlastní support je možný pouze na občerstvovačkách.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN Night Run Olomouc je největší běžeckou událostí v Olomouci, která se koná na Výstavišti Flora. Závod nabízí noční běh na 10 km, štafetu 2x5 km, charitativní běh na 5 km a rodinný běh na 3 km, včetně dětských závodů. Akce přináší nezapomenutelnou atmosféru, bohatý doprovodný program a podporu charitativních projektů. Každý účastník obdrží pamětní medaili a může si užít běh za svitu čelovek v nočním městě.
course_highlights: Noční běh městem Olomouc s atmosférou za svitu čelovek
Různé tratě od 300 m pro děti až po 10 km noční běh
Charitativní běh Bellis Run proti rakovině prsu
additional: Registrace a výdej startovních balíčků probíhá od 13:00 do 17:30 dle závodu. K dispozici je úschovna a šatny. Po závodě je možné využít doprovodný program včetně fotokoutku, malování na obličej, skákacího hradu, testování a prodeje běžeckého vybavení a doplňků výživy. Startovné je možné převést na jiného účastníka online nebo na místě za poplatek. V cíli obdrží všichni účastníci pamětní medaili. Zázemí závodu je na Výstavišti Flora. Online registrace končí 19. 10. 2026 v 18:00; registrace na místě závisí na volné kapacitě. Časový limit hlavního závodu je 90 minut.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Asuánu je tradiční krosový a trailový závod konaný na hrázi retenční nádrže Asuán v Praze 5-Jinonicích. Nabízí tratě různých délek pro všechny věkové kategorie, od nejmenších dětí až po dospělé, s mírně zvlněným terénem a přírodním povrchem, zakončeným asfaltovou cílovou rovinkou. Závod je organizován Atletikou Stodůlky z.s. a je přístupný pouze pěšky z okolních zastávek. Startovní poplatek je dobrovolný, což umožňuje širokou účast běžců všech úrovní.
course_highlights: Mírně zvlněná trať s přírodním povrchem
Cílová rovinka na asfaltu
Okruhy kolem retenční nádrže Asuán v Praze 5-Jinonicích
additional: Start a závodní kancelář je na jižním konci retenční nádrže Asuán, přístupný pouze pěšky od autobusových zastávek Ovčí hájek, Galerie Butovice a komplexu Volcano. Kategorie jsou rozděleny podle věku s různými délkami tratí od 250 m pro nejmenší až po 3600 m pro muže. Startovné je dobrovolné. Start a závodní kancelář jsou na jižním konci nádrže; přístup k nim je pouze pěšky. Informace o ročníku 2026 nejsou v dostupných zdrojích potvrzené.

name: ENSINGER Laufcup
location: Vaihingen an der Enz, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Ensinger Laufcup on 17 October 2026 offers runners of all ages and ability levels suitable distances in the beautiful region of Vaihingen an der Enz. The event includes a range of races, from Bambini runs to challenging trail routes of up to 24 kilometres and up to 700 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy the varied landscape of asphalt, gravel paths and trails. The Laufcup is also part of a regional support programme that helps schools and promotes community spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of routes from 550 m to 24 km, with up to 700 metres of elevation gain
A mix of asphalt, gravel forest paths and trails
Start and finish area in front of the Ensinger Kelter, with good public transport connections
additional: Online registration closes on 8 October 2026 at 23:59. Late registration is available online from 9 to 17 October 2026 for an additional fee, subject to places being available. All participants receive a medal at the finish. The event is part of the school support project run by the Alison and Peter Klein Stiftung, which covers registration fees and donates €5 to each participant’s school for every finisher. The start and finish area is at the square in front of the Ensinger Kelter on St. Veith-Straße. Parking is permitted only in designated areas; travel by public transport is recommended. Several race distances, trail and asphalt routes, detailed route information available

name: Altendorf-Ersdorfer Obstmeilenlauf
description: The Altendorf-Ersdorf Orchard Mile Run is a traditional fun run that has taken place every year since 1995 on the last Saturday in October. The event offers races for all ages and ability levels, including the Little Orchard Mile (5.3 km), the Big Orchard Mile (9.6 km) and the Mega Mile (16 km). The course runs through the picturesque orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf and is especially popular for the fresh apples at the finish and the fruit baskets awarded to the winners. There are also special children’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m. The run is a sociable event that combines running with nature and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Course through the orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf
Three main distances: 5.3 km, 9.6 km and 16 km
Children’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m
additional: The event is always held on the last Saturday in October. The runners meet regularly for training in the Altendorf-Ersdorf Forest. The winners receive generously filled fruit baskets, and fresh apples are handed out at the finish. The event includes distances of 400 m, 1 km, 3.3 miles, 6 miles and 10 miles. It is a family-friendly event with children’s and toddler races, held annually in October in Meckenheim.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg Run is a long-standing event taking place for the 29th time on October 24, 2026. Organized by TSG Helberhausen, it features a revised course that follows two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Running Series and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a multi-sport club with a wide range of activities, and organizes the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg Run course
Part of the Rothaar Running Series
A long-standing race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was revised for 2025. The event is part of TSG Helberhausen’s diverse sports program; the club has more than 20 departments and offers a wide range of sports. The 2026 anniversary edition features a special course layout, with all runners completing the routes in reverse. The event offers a range of competitions, including children’s races and Nordic walking, on a challenging, hilly course.

name: Internationaler Halbmarathon, 56. Internationaler Volkslauf
description: The International Half Marathon and International Volkslauf in Herzogenrath are established road races organized by DJK Jung Siegfried Herzogenrath. The event includes a 21.1 km half marathon and a 5 km Volkslauf, designed as a community race for all age groups. With the 46th edition of the half marathon and the 56th edition of the Volkslauf, the event has a long tradition and is listed in the laufen.de race calendar. The organizer is a multi-sport club that offers the community other sports and fitness activities in addition to running.
course_highlights: Road race in Herzogenrath
Officially measured half-marathon course (21.1 km)
5 km Volkslauf as a community race
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, mostly cloudy, average precipitation 40 mm. The event is integrated into local club activities and, alongside the race distances, offers a community atmosphere that encourages both sporting challenges and socializing.

name: NELLINGER Kirbe-Lauf
description: The Nellinger Kirbe Run is a long-standing recreational sporting event in Ostfildern-Nellingen, held annually in October. The main race covers approximately 7.3 km; there are also schoolchildren’s and Bambini races for younger participants. The event is organized by Turnverein Nellingen 1893 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a sporting challenge. The course runs through the town and is closed to vehicle traffic from 1:00 p.m. to ensure a safe race.
course_highlights: Main race: approx. 7.3 km (5 laps)
Schoolchildren’s race: approx. 1.45 km (1 lap)
Bambini race: approx. 400 m for children under 8
additional: The course is closed to vehicle traffic from 1:00 p.m. Parking is limited, so the use of public transport is recommended. Trophies are awarded to the overall winners, prizes to the top three finishers in each category, and team trophies for the schoolchildren’s race, main race, and company competition. The award ceremonies take place at 3:10 p.m., 4:20 p.m., and 4:40 p.m. The event also includes local awards, medical support from the DRK Ostfildern, and nearby parking. Registration is open from 31 August to 20 October 2026. Participation is intended only for those with adequate physical fitness.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.

name: Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd
location: Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd, Schwäbisch Gmünd, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held annually since 1991 during golden October. The 50-kilometer course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain crosses the Three Imperial Mountains—Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen—through breathtaking scenery. In addition to the main race, other events include the Alb Ultra at approx. 60 km, the 37 km Alb-Trail, a 25 km race, a 10 km run and walk, and a children’s race. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and a varied program including a talk, briefing and pasta party.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain across the Three Imperial Mountains: Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes
A range of distances, from the children’s race to the 60 km Alb Ultra
additional: Start for all races (except the Alb-Trail) is on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Event center at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing using a transponder in the race number (no ChampionChip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; medals for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by local and special buses is available to participants with a race number. Friday evening program includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward the meal). Loop course across the Imperial Mountains, aid stations, relay and team competitions, award ceremonies, race number with RFID transponder

name: Burgkirchner Raiffeisen-Crosslauf
location: Freizeitzentrum Halsbachgraben, Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Burgkirchner Raiffeisen Cross-Country Run is a hilly cross-country race in Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria. The start and finish are at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Cross-Country Series and offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including short courses from 0.65 km to 1.3 km and longer races of 4.5 km and 6.6 km. The course is challenging and hilly rather than flat, making even the short distances strenuous. Separate races for children and teenagers, as well as a special 6.6 km race for men, round out the programme.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country course, not a flat road
Start and finish at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre
Various distances for children, teenagers and adults
additional: Results, photos and further details are available at laufpix.de. Official information is also linked via crosslauf-is.de. Typical October weather: around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple course distances, separate categories for children and teenagers, not a flat road race, and a sporting challenge due to the hilly terrain

name: Gelenauer Erzgebirgscross
description: The Gelenau Erzgebirge Cross is a long-standing running event in the Erzgebirge, organised by LV 90 Erzgebirge. The competition takes place in Gelenau and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on a challenging course. The event is known for its scenic and varied cross-country course through the Erzgebirge. It is open to children, young people, adults and masters, and is a regular fixture in the regional athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Scenic cross-country course in the Erzgebirge
A range of courses for children, young people, adults and masters
Organised by the experienced LV 90 Erzgebirge
additional: The registration deadline is 2 November 2025. Entries should be sent to Sophia Teicher, Kemtauer Straße 27, 09423 Gelenau/Erzgebirge. The contact email is given as meldung "ät" lv90.de. The event includes various categories and age groups, with possible official results for rankings. October weather is typically cool, with temperatures around 14°C; rain is possible.

name: Lauf zur Crosslauf Serie im Kreis Bernkastel-Wittlich
description: The cross-country series in the Bernkastel-Wittlich district is a long-standing running event consisting of three races in Breit, Wintrich and Bengel. The series offers courses for various age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 200 to 7,400 metres. The races take place on varied cross-country courses through the sports grounds and surrounding terrain. Participants who take part in all three races receive a gift, and the series winners are honoured with certificates, prizes and cash awards for the middle- and long-distance events.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 200 m to 7,400 m for all age groups
Cross-country courses around the sports grounds in Breit, with the start and finish area by the festival hall
Showers and changing rooms available in the clubhouse at the sports grounds
additional: Late entries are accepted on site until 1 hour before the start, with a late-entry fee of €2.00. The event takes place at the sports grounds in Breit. Showers and changing rooms are available in the clubhouse at the sports grounds. After all three races, the series winners receive certificates and prizes; the overall middle- and long-distance winners also receive cash awards. Several race distances are offered, including children’s and adult categories, with medals, certificates and prizes. The event takes place in typical October weather, with temperatures around 14°C.

name: Lusatian Race Walking
price_range: 20-40 EUR pro Veranstaltung, kostenlos für Kinder unter 15 Jahren, zusätzlich 10 EUR bei Anmeldung vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: U18 und U20 – 20 EUR pro Veranstaltung

description: The Lusatian Race Walking is an internationally recognized race walking meeting taking place on 24 October 2026 at Weinauparkstadion in Zittau. The competitions cover various distances from 1 km to the marathon, held on an officially measured and certified 1-km loop on flat asphalt. The event is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver level and offers both elite and public races for various age groups. The organizers emphasize professional timekeeping, medical care and compliance with international competition rules.
course_highlights: Flat 1 km asphalt loop in Weinaupark, Zittau
Officially measured and certified course
Penalty Zone used for longer distances (5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon)
additional: Children up to age 15 can take part for free. Late entries are possible until 21 October 2026 for an additional fee of 20 EUR. Accreditation and race-number collection take place on 23 October from 16:00 to 18:00 and on 24 October from 8:00 onwards in the start and finish area. The marathon time limit is 4:45 hours. Doping controls are conducted in accordance with World Athletics and WADA. The race takes place on a flat asphalt course in Weinaupark in Zittau, with various categories for youth, adults and masters. Judging seminars are also held, and international competition rules are applied.

name: Alb Marathon
description: The Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has taken place every year since 1991 during golden October. The route covers 50 kilometres with 1,100 metres of elevation gain over the Three Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen, through breathtaking scenery. Alongside the classic marathon, other races include the Alb-Trail (37 km), the Alb-Ultra (approx. 60 km), as well as shorter distances and relay races suitable for runners of all ability levels. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family, with a varied programme including a talk, briefing and pasta party on the evening before the race.
course_highlights: 50 km route with 1,100 metres of elevation gain over the Three Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes on the Swabian Jura
A variety of races, from the Bambini run to the 60 km Alb-Ultra
additional: All races start on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Race headquarters are at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing uses a transponder in the race bib (no Champion Chip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; a medal for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by regular and special buses is available for participants with a race bib. The programme on Friday evening includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward costs). Several race distances are offered, including the 50 km Ultra, 37 km Trail, 25 km, 10 km and relay; the event includes a trail briefing, pasta party and family-friendly activities.

name: 100km Staffellauf um den Pokal der Uni Tübingen
B.U.T.XxX - BURGBERNHEIM ULTRA TRAIL
description: Der B.U.T.XxX - Burgbernheim Ultra Trail ist ein anspruchsvoller Ultratrail-Lauf in der malerischen Landschaft von Burgbernheim, Bayern. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern die Möglichkeit, die Natur und die abwechslungsreiche Strecke mit anspruchsvollen Anstiegen zu erleben. Der Lauf ist eine Herausforderung für erfahrene Trailrunner und fördert die Gemeinschaft unter den Teilnehmern. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Burgbernheim organisiert und findet jährlich statt.

name: Lauf der Crossserie des BLV-Kreises Ansbach
Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail-running and mountain-adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5,860 m and -5,970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participants can switch between courses until October 1, 2026. Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Starts are scheduled across October 17 and 18, 2026, with different start times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation changes. Courses include elevation gains of up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon distances, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Registration is available online, with options for entry-fee refunds and transfer of race packages.

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
description: The Run along the Čergov Ridge is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, intended for nature-running enthusiasts and trained runners. The course starts in the village of Kamenica and passes over the range’s highest peaks, including Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná. It is 32 km long, with 1,413 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy stunning panoramic views and challenging terrain on hiking trails. The race takes place on 24 October 2026, starting at 9:00 at Farma Kamenica and finishing at Sedlo Besná, near Hotel Šport Lysá.
course_highlights: 32 km mountain race with 1,413 m of elevation gain
Crosses the highest peaks of the Čergov Mountains: Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná
The route follows hiking trails marked blue and green
additional: A large bus will be provided for all participants, taking them in the morning from the village of Drienica to Kamenica (departing at 7:15 from the car park by Hotel JAVORNÁ). The organisers will also transport participants’ personal belongings from the start to the finish. Race-day registration is open from 7:00 to 8:30 at Farma Kamenica. The awards ceremony and lunch will be held at Hotel Šport Lysá. The race takes place on 24 October 2026 and is open to men and women in various age categories, offering the chance to take part in a mountain trail race amid the beautiful scenery of the Čergov Mountains.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: Ihrisko pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici, Rajec, Slovakia
distance_verbose: 13.7 km, 10 km, 8.3 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1 km
description: The Rajecká 12-Minute Run is a dynamic running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This short, intense run is ideal for runners of all levels who want to test their speed and endurance within a limited time. The event is part of the region’s running tradition and offers a pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community. The organizers ensure the course is well prepared and provide a welcoming environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Run on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec
Intense 12-minute time limit
Pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community
additional: Registration is online, with the option to pay later for an additional fee. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels. Refreshments are provided after the run, and results are announced at the venue. The race takes place on the sports field by the primary school on Lipová Street in Rajec, offering a chance to improve personal records in a friendly atmosphere.

description: The Run Through the Vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is a running event organized by the Bojničky Athletics Club and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place at the cultural center by the church in Bojničky and offers categories for men, women, and Nordic walking on a 6 km course. Registration fees can be paid online or on-site, with a discount for students. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: The course runs through the vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
Start at the cultural center by the church in Bojničky
additional: Categories: Men (M, M 40, M 50, M 60), Women (Ž, Ž 40, Ž 50), Nordic walking for men and women on the 6 km course. The registration fee can be paid online or on-site on race day. The event also includes Nordic walking; registration is available online, and the venue is the cultural center by the church in Bojničky.

name: Ružínska desiatka
price_range: 15,-€ online, 20,-€ na mieste; detské preteky 5,-€ online, 7,-€ na mieste
description: Ružínska Desiatka is a running race organized by Športový klub Jaklovce in cooperation with the municipality of Jaklovce, held by the Ružín Reservoir. The course is mostly asphalt with a small proportion of gravel, making for a fast and enjoyable run. Men and women compete in various age categories over 10 km and 5 km, and children’s races are also held. The main categories start at 11:00, and the children’s categories begin at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all levels.
course_highlights: 90% asphalt, 10% gravel (macadam)
The route runs around the Ružín Reservoir in Jaklovce
Categories for men, women, and children across various age groups
additional: The children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main categories at 11:00. Categories include various age groups for men and women, as well as overall rankings and special awards for the oldest, youngest, and best runners from Jaklovce. The course is mostly asphalt with a small proportion of gravel. The event includes 5 km and 10 km categories, children’s races, a raffle, and an inflatable bouncy castle.

name: Kobeřický půlmaraton
description: Kobeřický půlmaraton je tradiční atletický závod pořádaný TJ Sokol Kobeřice, který má dlouholetou historii sahající až do roku 1996. Závod je součástí mistrovství Moravy a Slezska a přitahuje běžce z celé České republiky i zahraničí. Trať nabízí příležitost pro zkušené i rekreační běžce a je součástí série veřejných závodů pořádaných oddílem atletiky v Kobeřicích. Organizátoři kladou důraz na podporu mládeže a rozvoj běžeckých tradic v regionu.
course_highlights: Tradiční půlmaratonská trať v Kobeřicích s historií od roku 1996
Součást mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu
Přírodní a městské úseky vhodné pro různé úrovně běžců
additional: Závod je součástí série tří veřejných běhů pořádaných TJ Sokol Kobeřice, včetně Zimního běhu Kobeřicemi a Kobeřické dvacítky. Atletický oddíl se zaměřuje na mládež a má dlouhodobou tradici v regionu. V roce 1998 byl půlmaraton zařazen do mistrovství Moravy a Slezska, v roce 2005 a 2009 se zde konala mistrovství v půlmaratonu a veteránů. Závod je součástí Moravskoslezského běžeckého poháru a Prajzsko-opavské běžecké ligy, s historií a tradicí v regionu.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole je seriál veřejných běžeckých závodů pořádaných v různých městských částech Prahy, jehož cílem je podpořit zdravý životní styl a sounáležitost obyvatel s jejich městskou částí. Závod v Praze 6 se koná v parku Ladronka a je součástí tohoto seriálu, kde každý účastník reprezentuje svou městskou část a přispívá k soutěži o nejsportovnější městskou část Prahy. Akce je vhodná pro všechny věkové kategorie včetně dětí, seniorů a handicapovaných. Pořadatelé připravují originální medaile a příjemnou atmosféru pro všechny běžce.
course_highlights: Závod v parku Ladronka v Praze 6
Seriál běhů po městských částech Prahy
Podpora zdravého životního stylu a komunitního ducha
additional: Každý účastník reprezentuje svou městskou část dle místa trvalého bydliště a přispívá k bodování městských částí v seriálu. Pořadatelé připravují speciální medaile pro jednotlivé kategorie jako památku na závod. race series with multiple events, terrain details not specified, registration info on website

name: Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a long-standing running event in Glauchau, held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and ability levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km and 1.1 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes pass through the scenic surrounding area on asphalt and paved paths, including sections alongside the reservoir and the castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running to experience autumn actively.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat scenic run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km course with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the grounds of the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau
additional: Half-marathon time limit: 2:45 h. Intermediate checkpoint at km 14.3 (reservoir pavilion) must be passed by 12:00; otherwise, disqualification with a shortened course to the finish. Race number includes a baggage tag and a raffle ticket. Recommended parking: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße. Late registration/changes possible on 24.10.2026 from 13:00 to 14:30, with a late registration fee of 5 euros. Registration opens on 01.08.2026. Race numbers include chips; age-group rankings, team and special rankings. No refunds. Limits apply to the company and family runs and Special Olympics. Participation includes shipping of the entry fee.

name: Olympiaberg-Cross München mit Deutschem Cross Cup
organizer: Förderverein Leichtathletik & Events München e. V.
price_range: Männer/Frauen 18 Euro, Jugend 8 Euro, Kinder 8 Euro, Barfußlauf 8 Euro
description: The Olympiaberg Cross Munich is a challenging cross-country race in Munich’s historic Olympic Park, taking place on October 25, 2026. The course follows a loop of approximately 1,100 metres, with several notable climbs and obstacles such as straw-bale sections. The race is part of the German Cross Cup and offers age-group and team classifications. Elite runners can win cash prizes, and all participants receive a certificate through an online service.
course_highlights: Approximately 1,100-metre loop with several marked uphill sections
Four numbered straw-bale sections as technical obstacles
Start and finish in the central area of Olympiaberg in Munich’s Olympic Park
additional: Online registration is possible until 60 minutes before the respective start. DLV start authorisation requires the DLV start-pass number and DLV regional association to be provided. All participants can use an online service to print their certificates. Separate age-group and team classifications are available (U12 to U18). Barefoot runners receive a special gift. The course features climbs and obstacles (straw bales) and is a challenging, hilly route. Online registration. Start and finish in Munich’s Olympic Park.

description: The Ottenstein Wottellauf is a long-standing running event held annually in Ottenstein near Ahaus. The event offers various races for children and adults, including 10 km, 5 km, and several shorter children’s races. The races start at Sportplatz 1, 48683 Ahaus-Ottenstein, and are known for their friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. All participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies, making the race especially appealing to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportplatz 1 in Ahaus-Ottenstein
A range of distances from 200 m to 10 km
Friendly atmosphere with awards for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Showers and changing rooms are available at the venue. An unattended bag drop is available. Certificates are provided online. Trophies are awarded to places 1–3 in the 5 km and 10 km races. Every child receives a medal. Prizes are awarded to the largest group. Photos and videos are taken during the event and used for press and social media. Registration until 23.10.2025, start times from 11:05, showers and changing rooms available, photos and videos during the event

name: Starzachlauf
description: The Starzach Run is a long-standing running event in Wachendorf, offering various distances for all age groups. The routes pass through the beautiful countryside around Starzach and offer a varied experience for both recreational and competitive runners. In addition to the main race, there are children’s and youth races, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is family-friendly and known for its welcoming atmosphere and good organisation.
course_highlights: 10.7 km main race through the Starzach countryside
5.2 km recreational run
Children’s and youth races over distances of approximately 400 m to 1,300 m
additional: Race number collection from 8:00 a.m. at the Starzach Wachendorf multipurpose hall. Electronic timing with a transponder (provided with the race documents). Awards ceremony at approximately 12:00 p.m. at the multipurpose hall. Prizes for overall winners and age-group winners; medals for children’s race participants. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before the start, with a €3 late-entry fee. Distances: 10.7 km, 5.2 km, children’s and youth races; registration until 22 October 2026; prizes for winners and children’s groups; refreshments available on site.

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt Volkswaldlauf takes place on 25 October 2026 in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground
Event as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports ground is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground; October weather: approx. 14°C, 6°C low, 40mm of precipitation, cloudy

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat races for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main race is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini race for the youngest participants and a 1 km students’ race, allowing families and club runners to take part together, with participants grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Races for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are grouped by distance and age category. There is a 400 m Bambini race and a 1 km students’ race. All races finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of events, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbst Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, starting and finishing at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course is a flat 5-kilometer loop on paved and mixed surfaces that also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on paved and mixed surfaces
Course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run with medals and certificates.

name: Oldenburg Marathon / Oldenburg Marathon 2026
price_range: 35 Euro für das Sportshirt (zusätzliche Startgebühren nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on 25 October 2026 offers a wide range of races: the EWE Marathon, public half marathon, AZO Half Marathon Relay, 10 km Volksbank City Run, 5 km Müller & Egerer Run, and Decathlon Children’s Mile Run. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part in different disciplines. The course runs through the city of Oldenburg and offers a great running experience for participants of all abilities. Registered participants can also purchase a high-quality, sustainable long-sleeved shirt.
course_highlights: A wide range of distances, from the marathon to the children’s run
Course through the city of Oldenburg
10:00 a.m. start time for the shorter races
additional: Race packets can be collected on 11 October from 11 a.m. at the Schlosshöfe. Saturday’s pre-race check-in, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., is recommended. Group registration is available. A high-quality, sustainable long-sleeved shirt by Wijld is available for €35 only when registering. Race numbers may also be collected by family members. Multiple race distances, start locations in Oldenburg, special medals, event merchandise, and information about race numbers and registration.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, taking place on 25 October 2026. The event offers a half marathon as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The courses are officially measured by the DLV and are therefore eligible for rankings. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners in various age categories and overall standings.
course_highlights: DLV-measured half-marathon course to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional events
Awards for places 1–6 in the overall standings
additional: Certificates can be downloaded from the timekeeper’s website, www.timeteam-jung.de. Awards ceremonies will take place in the tent as soon as possible after the races. Parking is available at Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. DJK Gütersloh accepts no liability for accidents, theft or other damage. Measurement to DLV/IAAF/AIMS standards, online registration, parking at Hauptschule Nord, disclaimer of liability, certificates via www.timeteam-jung.de

name: Friedrichstaler Waldlauf
description: The Friedrichstal Forest Run is part of the Stutensee Cup and will be held for the 11th time in 2026. The event comprises four scoring races over 10 km. Runners are automatically included in the standings if they take part in at least three races. The course offers an attractive running opportunity in autumnal Friedrichstal and welcomes runners of all ability levels. The five fastest runners will be honored after the final race on October 25, 2026. The event is organized by TV Friedrichstal 1899 e.V., the largest club in Stutensee.
course_highlights: Four scoring races over 10 km
Run through the autumnal Friedrichstal Forest
Take part in at least three races to qualify for the Stutensee Cup standings
additional: The five fastest runners will be honored after the Friedrichstal Forest Run on 25.10.2026. Registration opens in September. Runners are automatically included in the Stutensee Cup standings after taking part in at least three of the four 10 km races. If they take part in all four races, their three fastest times count. Registration opens in September, nature experience, community event

description: The FSV Run takes place on October 25, 2026, in the Brucker Lache in Erlangen and offers races for all age groups, from Bambinis to adults. The course is a relatively flat 5 km loop, which runners complete twice for the 10 km race. Alongside the sporting experience, social engagement is also a focus: €2 per participant is donated to the Förderverein Erlanger Tafel. Children can enjoy medals and face painting, and free fruit, tea and non-alcoholic wheat beer are available in the finish area. The event also prioritizes environmental protection, for example by allowing participants to label and store their own bottles.
course_highlights: Relatively flat 5 km loop in the Brucker Lache
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Course suitable for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 1 hour before the starts, for a €2 late-registration fee. The Bambini and schoolchildren’s races are free. There is face painting, medals for children, changing facilities at the primary school, and free refreshments in the finish area, including fruit, tea and non-alcoholic wheat beer. The event supports the Förderverein Erlanger Tafel with donations per participant. Races over 0.4 km, 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus relay races; registration online and on the day of the event; eco-friendly travel by bicycle or bus; children’s activities and refreshments on site; donations to the Erlanger Tafel

name: Lauf um den Eisbrunn - 1. Lauf der Jedermannserie
location: Sportgelände des SV Mauren, Harburg, Donau-Ries, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Lauf um den Eisbrunn kicks off the LG Donau-Ries everyone’s running series in late autumn. The road race takes place in Harburg, with the start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds. Events include a main race of approximately 10 km, a 3 km short race, and a 7 km walking route. The event welcomes all running enthusiasts, from children to club runners, and offers a friendly atmosphere for individual entrants and series runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SV Mauren sports grounds in Harburg
Main race of approx. 10 km, plus a 3 km short race and a 7 km walking route
Local late-autumn road race with typical October weather around 14 °C
additional: Race numbers with transponders are distributed on site before the start. The main race starts in the morning, followed by the shorter events. The series concludes with a final in Nördlingen on the third Sunday of Advent. A local race for all age groups, including children, teenagers, adults, and walkers. The series finale in Nördlingen offers community runners a good opportunity to prepare for winter.

name: Ohmbachsee Halbmarathon
location: Turn- und Festhalle Brücken, Brücken, Kusel, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Ohmbachsee Half Marathon is a long-standing race held annually at the picturesque Ohmbachsee in Brücken. The course passes through varied landscapes and offers runners an appealing mix of nature and sporting challenge. The event is organized by Laufgemeinschaft Ohmbachsee e.V. and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race starts at the Turn- und Festhalle Brücken, which also serves as the central meeting point.
course_highlights: Run along the picturesque Ohmbachsee
Varied natural course with forest and lakeside sections
Start and finish at the Turn- und Festhalle Brücken
additional: The race takes place on 25 October 2026, starting at 10:00 a.m. at the Turn- und Festhalle Brücken. The course is approximately 21 km long and runs from Dellstraße to the Ohmbachsee. Registration is available online and on site. The event is scheduled to take place in all weather conditions and has an established place in the regional running scene.

name: Pfinztallauf
description: The Pfinztal Run is a traditional event held annually at Hopfenberg Stadium in Pfinztal. The course runs through the idyllic countryside along the Pfinz, passing Söllingen and Kleinsteinbach, with a turnaround point in Kleinsteinbach. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to 10 km runs. After finishing in the stadium, participants can enjoy a warm atmosphere with an awards ceremony, trophies, medals, and a large cake buffet in the TSV hall.
course_highlights: The route runs through Pfinztal and along a scenic section of the Pfinz
Turnaround point at the Kleinsteinbach festival grounds
Finish at Hopfenberg Stadium, with a stadium announcer
additional: Start times: 09:30 for the 3 km school team race and 5 km run, 10:00 for the 10 km run, and from 11:15 for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races. The course partly follows cycle paths and roads, including railway underpasses. After the race, there is a large cake buffet and an awards ceremony with trophies, medals, and certificates in the TSV hall. The event offers a range of distances, including school and youth competitions, with refreshments and an awards ceremony at Hopfenberg Stadium.

name: Porzellinerlauf
location: Sportplatz Am Dohlenstein, Kahla, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Porzellinerlauf Kahla is a traditional autumn road race starting and finishing at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground in Kahla, Thuringia. The 13 km race is the main event, alongside shorter children’s and youth races, making the day appealing to both families and regular runners. Organised by SV 1910 Kahla e.V. since 1971, the race combines a sporting challenge with the local porcelain tradition. Regional timekeepers oversee the course, which receives particularly positive feedback for its route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground
13 km main race, with shorter children’s and youth races
Route through Kahla with a connection to its porcelain tradition
additional: The field is modest, with around 101 to 300 runners and more than one hundred finishers in recent editions. Typical November weather in Kahla is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. Timing is provided by regional timekeepers. The race has been established since 1971 and regularly attracts between 101 and 300 participants. The course is known for its good condition and attractive surroundings. The event also includes refreshments, showers and an awards ceremony.

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: Thüngersheimer Bocksbeutellauf 2026
description: The Thüngersheim Bocksbeutel Run is a traditional race held annually in Thüngersheim. The event offers runners of all ages a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, with a generous runners’ buffet, a large cake and coffee bar, and a medal and bottle of wine for every finisher. Children receive a small gift. The race is a celebration of the local running community, combining sporting ambition with a sociable gathering.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque wine region around Thüngersheim
Generous runners’ buffet and large cake and coffee bar
A bottle of wine for every finisher, or a gift for children
additional: Every finisher receives a medal and a bottle of wine; children receive a small gift. A generous runners’ buffet and a large cake and coffee bar are available. Registration is open until 14.09.2026 to benefit from lower fees. Distances: 600 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; date: 25 October 2026; local race, family- and club-friendly

name: Freisinger Strassenlauf pwd. by Munich Airport
16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night marathon and half marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nighttime ambience. The course consists of laps of approximately 7 kilometres, completed multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has official PZLA certification, which verifies the course distance and makes it possible to set world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners who want to improve their personal bests in the one-of-a-kind conditions of a night race.
course_highlights: The course consists of laps of approximately 7 km, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirms the course distance
Views of the stadium along the course and Koszalin’s undulating terrain
additional: The race office for children and young people opens at around 19:00, with a limited number of places (20). The race office for adults is located in the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at ul. Racławicka, about 300 m from the stadium, and remains open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants must show a photo ID when collecting their race number. The course runs along the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. The medal and merchandise are updated each year and are an important part of the event. The event offers different distances, including a marathon and half marathon, with reports, photo and video galleries, and options to register online or at the race office. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the chance to compete in various themed categories.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic, Arka Tołłoczko, Rafał Malitkowski
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The 42.195 km course follows forest and rural roads in a peaceful, uncrowded setting, with course markings and convenient access. The event is organized by local runners, who prioritize a friendly atmosphere and a recreational experience over competition and prizes. It is an excellent choice for fans of cross-country running in natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course along forest and rural roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Every kilometre marked, with convenient parking
additional: No crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without the pressure of competition. The course is laid out and marked by the “Harcownik” Running Club. Participants can take part in a series of four marathons per year on the same course. The event is friendly and recreational in nature. Napoleonic Marathon, mainly urban parkland terrain, training preparations, online registration, various distances, entries, regulations, GPX routes.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual half-marathon held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants can run a route through charming parts of the city, finishing at ERGO Arena, which offers a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive race packs. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of sport in the Pearl of the Baltic and earn a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades
The finish is located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and Sopot’s iconic pier
additional: The race pack includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half-marathon route is certified and passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades. The finish is inside ERGO Arena, providing comfortable conditions for runners after the race. Race packs available from 10 February 2026; participant limit: 3,500; discounts for holders of the Sopot Card; the event is part of the Korona Półmaratonów Pomorza 2026–2030 series.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
price_range: Półmaraton: od 50 PLN do 180 PLN, Maraton: od 60 PLN do 220 PLN
description: The 14th Vistula River Run along the Lower Vistula Valley Trail is an annual race held in Tczew County. Participants can choose between two distances: a certified 42.195 km marathon and an uncertified 21.097 km half marathon. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Vistula Valley and feature a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00, and the half marathon starts in Małe Walichnowy at 11:00. Both finish in Tczew.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The route is marked every 1 km with painted markings and yellow signs
additional: The limit is 400 paid participants. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon route is PZLA-certified; the half marathon is not. The finish is at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew, ul. Bałdowska 19. The routes have varied surfaces. The participant limit is 400, registration is online, and the event includes a half marathon and a marathon.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: The Perła Paprocan Run is a unique marathon around Paprocany Lake in Tychy, combining competition with training over almost any distance. Runners can complete one or more laps of the 7-kilometre loop, up to the full marathon distance. The event is recreational and community-oriented, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a welcoming atmosphere among runners. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Paprocany Lake
Paved sections (over 50%), as well as compacted paths and forest trails
A refreshment point with drinks, fruit, and sweets available after each lap
additional: Start and finish at the Paprocany Holiday Centre, ul. Parkowa 17, Tychy. Race bibs can be collected in the days before the event and on race day. The participant limit is 1111. Runners do not need to declare their distance before the race and can change it during the event. Participants aged 12 and over may take part with the written consent of a parent or guardian. Valuables can be left in the baggage deposit. The event is recreational, and runners must keep to one half of the paths to allow others to overtake. Participation from age 12 with a guardian’s consent, refreshment points with drinks and fruit, a limit of 1111 participants, online registration, and an event held twice a year.
